changes.source: It reminds me something. If I remember correctly, it was a cult of demonists established in the Empire several centuries ago by a heretic named Lucius. He declared himself the Dark prophet of Satan and started to proclaim speedy fall of the God's earthly realm. He gathered numerous fanatics, which pinned their faith to him and supposed that before long the world will end. Eventually all were caught and burned, even though many of them were of high status. Why do you think judge Vallarian would be a part of the long dead cult? I'm sure there is plenty of new ones these days.
changes.before: 这让我想起了一些事。如果我没记错的话，那是数个世纪前在帝国境内由一个名叫卢修斯的异端所建立的恶魔崇拜教团。他自封为撒旦的暗黑先知，开始宣扬上帝的尘世国度将迅速覆灭。他聚集了众多狂信徒，他们将信仰寄托于他，认为世界不久便会终结。最终所有人都被抓获并烧死，尽管其中许多人身份显赫。你为什么认为瓦拉里安法官会与那个早已覆灭的教团有关？我敢肯定如今有的是新教团。
changes.after: 这让我想起了一些事。如果我没记错的话，那是数个世纪前在帝国境内由一个名叫卢修斯的异端所建立的恶魔崇拜教团。他自封为撒旦的黑暗先知，开始宣扬上帝的尘世国度将迅速覆灭。他聚集了众多狂信徒，他们将信仰寄托于他，认为世界不久便会终结。最终所有人都被抓获并烧死，尽管其中许多人身份显赫。你为什么认为瓦拉里安法官会与那个早已覆灭的教团有关？我敢肯定如今有的是新教团。

changes.source: Unbelievable! Are you telling me that Bishop Herbertius rose from his grave? That's infernal! And as if it was not enough, according to your words priest Romius was commanded by that spawn of darkness to steal the monstrance. A priest of the Holy Mother Church enthralled by infernal powers... I find it hard to believe, nevertheless I can't doubt your words. It is obvious that heresy has rooted itself deep in this town—it has infected even the ranks of the Church. Nevertheless I am glad to say that you completed your task with excellence! The monstrance is back and the perpetrator is revealed. That means I'm free to declare you a commander of the Brotherhood. That is if you've already proven your courage in fighting and killed more than a hundred enemies...
changes.before: 难以置信！你是说赫伯提乌斯主教从坟墓中爬了出来？这简直是地狱之物！更糟的是，据你所言，罗米乌斯牧师是受那黑暗之裔的命令偷走了圣体光。一位圣母教会的牧师被地狱之力蛊惑……我难以置信，但我不怀疑你的话。异端显然已在这座城镇深深扎根——甚至感染了教会内部。不过我很高兴地说，你出色地完成了任务！圣体光已寻回，罪魁祸首也已查明。这意味着我可以宣布你为兄弟会指挥官了。前提是你已在战斗中证明了勇气，并斩杀了一百多个敌人……

changes.source: To tell the truth I know Juhasz Gotherr personally—although I wish I never met him. Because of that I'm convinced that he stays here in Alvaron. Several times I had a feeling I see him creeping through the city at night. But although I always reported it both to the Inquisition and to the town guard, he was not captured. He is devious like Satan himself!
changes.before: 说实话，我认识尤哈什·戈特尔本人——虽然我希望自己从未见过他。因此我确信他就藏在阿尔瓦伦。有好几次，我感觉看见他在夜里潜行穿过全城。但尽管我每次都向宗教裁判所和城防卫队报告，他仍未被捕获。他狡诈得如同撒旦本尊！

changes.source: Because I'm very worried—lately there have been too many graves robbed here in Alvaron. Well, I should explain myself, I'm Augustin and I'm in charge of the city cemetery and the sepulcher. So you surely can imagine my grievance about the crimes which some unknown heretics commit by robbing the graves and disturbing not only the remembrance of the deceased, but also their eternal peace. Only God knows how many dead have risen just because of those sacrilegious thieves!
changes.before: 因为我非常忧虑——最近阿尔瓦伦有太多坟墓被盗掘了。好吧，我该自我介绍一下，我是奥古斯丁，负责管理城中公墓和地下墓室。所以你一定能想象，对于某些不明身份的异教徒盗掘坟墓、不仅打扰死者的追思、更打扰他们永恒安息的罪行，我是多么愤慨。只有上帝知道，有多少死者正是因为那些亵渎神圣的窃贼而起身复活！

changes.source: I don't say that it's the most interesting event of these days, but I was in Salena Flock's pub and I overheard a conversation between that odd trader Ihman ab Sahab and priest Gilbert. The trader was persuading the priest to get him a copy of the Legend of Saint Orthenius from the ancient Killian's Chronicle which is stored in the archiepiscopal archives.
changes.before: 我可不是说这是最近最引人注目的事件，当时我在萨莱娜·弗洛克的酒馆里，无意间听到了那个古怪商人伊赫曼·阿布·萨哈布和牧师吉尔伯特的对话。那个商人正在说服这位牧师，替他从保存在大主教档案馆里的古老《基利安编年史》中抄录一份《圣奥塞尼乌斯传说》。

changes.source: Whatever quest brought you to Alvaron, Father, stay away from the cemetery—it's crawling with evil! And when I say evil, I mean real EVIL! Living dead are feasting on the graves and coffins at night, still night air is chilled by floating ghosts and dark shadows are stalked by nameless horrors. It's rumored that everybody who enters won't be seen again, unless as one of them...

changes.source: Heresy of Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert would explain much, my son. For example why has been the Grand Master putting so much effort into trying to suppress the jurisdiction of the Inquisition since the King signed Decretum Inquisitorium. And it is true that many of the citizens of Alvaron are convinced Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert really is a heretic. It's just another reason for common folk to fear what the future will bring them—where the heresy will end, after all, if it can taint even the head of a knightly order?!
changes.before: 克里斯托弗·德·马拉梅特大团长若为异端，许多事情便说得通了，我的孩子。比如，自国王签署《异端审判法令》以来，大团长为何一直竭力压制宗教裁判所的管辖权。而且阿尔瓦伦的许多市民确实深信克里斯托弗·德·马拉梅特大团长是异端。这也成了平民百姓恐惧未来又一个理由——如果连骑士团的首领都会被异端玷污，那异端究竟会蔓延到何处？！

changes.source: You want to know who are Arthamon, Baphomet, Cerdie and Azrael? Then know that they are the archenemies of God Almighty, the architects of evil, the tempters of nations and the rulers of the fallen souls. They are terrible tools of Satan in his hellish plans, his staunch vassals and executors of his evil will. Nobody and no one in this world may stand against them, because they are godlike beings, peerless and absolute.
changes.before: 你想知道阿尔萨蒙、巴弗灭、塞尔迪和阿兹瑞尔是谁？那么你听着：他们是全能的上帝的宿敌，是邪恶的建筑师，是引诱万民的蛊惑者，是堕落灵魂的统治者。他们是撒旦地狱图谋中的可怖工具，是他忠实的封臣与邪恶意志的执行者。世上无人能与他们抗衡，因为他们如同神明，无可匹敌，至高无上。

changes.source: Of course I know about the Children of the New Order. It was a cult gathered around certain Lucius in the tenth century. Lucius declared himself the Dark prophet and proclaimed the end of the world and coming of a perverted new order. Its children were supposed to rule the world alongside with Satan. The cult was dangerous in that it grew through all the layers of society and involved even the highest classes—both secular and clerical. Despite of that the Holy Office managed to uncover the heretics and execute them including Lucius in 1021. All that fortunately happened in the Empire, hundreds of miles away from the Realm. Thereby I'm very unnerved by notion the cult might have survived and even relocated itself here to Ultherst.
changes.before: 我当然知道新秩序之子。那是一个围绕十世纪某个卢修斯聚集的邪教。卢修斯自封为暗黑先知，宣告世界末日与一个堕落新秩序的降临。他的子民要与撒旦一同统治世界。该邪教之所以危险，在于它渗透了社会各阶层，甚至连最高层——世俗与教会——都未能幸免。即便如此，圣务院还是于1021年查明了这些异端并将其处决，卢修斯亦在其中。所幸这一切发生在帝国境内，距王国足有数百英里。因此，当想到该邪教或许幸存至今，甚至已迁至乌尔瑟斯特时，我深感不安。

changes.source: Monsters and beasts have been plaguing Alvaron since time immemorial, Father. But after the Star of Doom appeared in the sky, all hell broke lose. Look at the municipal cemetery—it's supposed to be a place of eternal rest of the deceased but instead, it's been flooded with so much evil that nobody dares to go there. During the nights, living corpses feast on graves and coffins, ghosts fly in the air and in the shadows you can sense a nameless terror floating!

changes.source: For their service to the Realm of course! The Drichtmauls rule the hammer and the steel since time immemorial. And nobody compares to us, except for the royal armorers in Alvaron, of course. Since 745, when my ancestor Eugen Drichtmaul settled here in Glatzburg, we've been supplying first class weapons and armor far and wide. It was, however, my grand-grandfather Bonhart von Drichtmaul who gained the title of Baron for a plate armor made for the then governor of the city Grand Duke Gerhard. It was a powerful magic armor which saved the Grand Duke's life in many battles with the barbarian raiders.

changes.source: It used to be like that until the year 223, when St. Orthenius and his righteous armies captured Galibornium. The coliseum was ruined and all its underground—where the gladiators prepared for the fight—was entombed. All who were hiding there from the war starved to death. It's said that people still can hear moaning and howling of ghosts from the depths under the coliseum.

changes.source: One day he attacked and killed several innocent people in an unexpected fit of rage. It happened during daytime, just a few days after he returned from a long quest to seek and destroy the settlement of an ancient evil somewhere in Schwarzwald. After his act of insanity he immediately fled from the city and he's been strolling aimlessly around Alvaron killing everyone he meets. None of us knows what happened to him, but we would like to help him. However, our investigation led us nowhere. It is because of that we came to ask the Holy Office, but we were told the paladin would be executed as a heretic if he is caught alive. We aren't going to allow that!
changes.before: 一日，他在突如其来的暴怒中袭击并杀害了数名无辜之人。事情发生在白天，就在他结束漫长征讨归来后数日——那场征讨是要在黑森林某处寻获并摧毁上古邪恶的巢穴。犯下这桩疯狂之举后，他立刻逃离了城市，此后一直在阿尔瓦伦一带漫无目的地游荡，见人便杀。我们无人知晓他究竟遭遇了什么，但我们愿意帮他。然而调查毫无所获。正因如此，我们才来求告圣务院，却被告知：那名圣骑士若被活捉，将以异端之名处决。我们绝不答应！

changes.source: Our fellow paladin Richwald d'Blazier. We still mourn his death and pray for the salvation of his soul. First of all, this lecherous witch bewitched him with her beauty and then—with the help of dark powers—turned him to stone! We have been searching for her for many weeks before we were able to hunt her down like the wild beast she is. Deep in Schwarzwald she was hidden, like the other beasts and hellspawns lurking around Alvaron these days. But she didn't escape righteous justice in the end.

changes.source: I do know something about the cult of the Children of the New Order. If I remember it well, it was a rather numerous and quickly spreading cult of the demon-invocators that was created in the Empire during the restless times at the end of the tenth century. The cult was founded by a self-appointed Dark Prophet named Lucius who foretold the End of the World and the release of Satan from his one thousand years imprisonment. Soon the cult found some members also among the gentry and nobles and then it became a really dangerous movement, which was a hard nut to crack for the Inquisition. Fortunately for Ultherst the cult of the Children of the New Order didn't spread into the other faithful countries and because of that we were spared from the grim raging of the Holy Office. What came to pass in the end was what had to come to pass—all members of the cult were caught and executed, including the members of the Emperor's family. Several hundred heretics were burned in the Emperor's Square in Bonorium in 1021. And that was the end of the cult of the Children of the New Order.
changes.before: 我对新秩序之子教团确实略知一二。若我记得没错，那是个人数众多、蔓延迅速的召唤恶魔者教团，于十世纪末的动荡年代在帝国境内兴起。教团由一个自称暗黑先知、名为卢修斯的人创立，他预言了世界末日，以及撒旦将从千年囚禁中被释放。不久，教团在乡绅阶层与贵族中也吸纳了些许成员，遂成了一股真正危险的势力，令宗教裁判所颇为棘手。所幸的是，新秩序之子教团并未蔓延至其他信仰虔诚的国家，我们因此免于圣务院的残酷蹂躏。最终，该发生的事终究发生了——教团全体成员尽数被捕处决，其中包括皇帝家族的成员。1021年，数百名异端在博诺里乌姆的皇帝广场被处以火刑。新秩序之子教团也就此覆灭。

changes.source: The Fallen Angels are the minions of Satan and the most powerful demons who have ever lived in Hell. Sources other than the Scriptures mention them, thus we can expect they were known already in pagan times. They impersonate the antithesis of God Almighty, just as darkness is the opposite of light. There're four of them: Arthamon, the Master of Destruction, Baphomet, the Ruler of Madness, Cerdie, the Mistress of Fornication and the Fallen Archangel Azrael, the first of the servants of Satan. Each of the Fallen Angels controls one of the Chaos elements—destruction, madness and lechery. Since the Dawn of Time, when they were thrown down from the sky together with Satan for the crimes they committed, they've been imprisoned in Hell. Only their lesser servants can get into our world directly, but they can affect our world with their power, by affecting human minds—and this is the way that sin and misdemeanor come into this world. And they are very successful in their effort! Tell me frankly, Father—do you think there has been any lack of destruction, madness and of lechery in the world in recent years?
changes.before: 堕落天使是撒旦的仆从，是地狱中有史以来最强大的恶魔。除了圣典之外，其他典籍也提及过他们，可见在异教时代他们便已为人所知。他们自居为全能的上帝的对立面，正如黑暗是光明的反面。共有四位：毁灭之主阿尔萨蒙，疯狂之主巴弗灭，淫欲之主瑟尔迪，以及堕落大天使阿兹瑞尔——撒旦的首席仆从。每位堕落天使掌控一种混沌元素——毁灭、疯狂与淫欲。自太初之时起，他们因所犯之罪与撒旦一同被逐出天界，便被囚禁于地狱之中。只有他们低等的仆从能直接进入我们的世界，但他们能以力量影响人类的心智，从而左右我们的世界——罪恶与堕落正是由此降临尘世。而且他们屡试屡成！坦白告诉我，神父——您觉得近年来这世上还缺少毁灭、疯狂与淫欲吗？

Because I must say that not a single day passes here in Alvaron without meeting a whole army of pale chicken-hearts lamenting about everything they have already met or they have been afflicted by. changes.source: I don't know if you've heard about it, but if you have stayed in Alvaron for some time already, this cause must have reached your ears. It's about Baron Dawn von Blutenreich. I mean, about the mansion he left us. The Baron was the last descendant of an ancient House that lived in Alvaron for many hundred years. He was very a rich man and pretty reputable in the community, but—as it was found out later—he was a terrible pervert and deviant from an ethical point of view—keen on cruelty and torture since babyhood. However, during his first marriage he turned into a complete bloodthirsty monster, who tortured his wife and three children to death.
changes.before: 我不知道你是否听说过，但如果你在阿尔瓦伦已经待过一段时间，这件事一定早已传到了你耳中。是关于道恩·冯·布卢滕里希男爵的事。我是说，关于他留给我们的那座宅邸。男爵是一个古老家族的最后后裔，该家族在阿尔瓦伦居住了数百年。他非常富有，在社群中也颇有声望，但——正如后来查明的那样——他是一个可怕的变态，在道德上完全堕落——从婴儿时期就热衷于残忍与酷刑。然而，在他的第一次婚姻期间，他变成了一个嗜血的怪物，将妻子和三个孩子折磨致死。

changes.source: The truth is there are not many people here in Alvaron that would believe the Grand Master is innocent. Many a person thinks he's mixed up in a conspiracy against God and the King. Whatever the truth is, I think he has earned it mainly by his great efforts to suppress the jurisdiction of the Inquisition. It may be that he has acted out of honest reasons, but it also may be quite opposite. I can't judge that. In any case if evidence speaks against him, there's nothing to discuss.

changes.source: Yes, I do. According to the confession of Sven Larsen Seneschal Jean de Guise ordered the murder of the paladin Eradim d'Chambrie because the paladin decided to denounce the Seneschal to the Inquisition. Then I managed to get the confession of Seneschal's underling Downay who confessed he perpetrated many disgusting crimes at Seneschal's bidding. And finally I have the confession of the royal counselor Verenicus who pleaded he threw a dark curse upon Prince Louis together with Jean de Guise two years ago!
changes.before: 有的。据斯文·拉森供述，管家让·德·吉斯下令谋杀了圣骑士埃拉迪姆·德·尚布里，因为这名圣骑士打算向宗教裁判所揭发管家。此后，我设法取得了管家的部下道奈的供词，他承认自己奉管家之命犯下了许多令人发指的罪行。最后，我还有皇家顾问维雷尼库斯的供词——他亲口承认，两年前他曾与让·德·吉斯一同对路易王子施下了黑暗诅咒！

changes.source: There were quite a lot of people brutally murdered in Alvaron and its vicinity recently. And at least the same number has gone missing without a trace. People usually blame wolf-prince Wulfhyrr and his packs of werewolves for it, but I'd say that other hellspawns have their hands in it too. I wouldn't be surprised if it is a part of Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert's plan to disrupt the Realm and to seize control of it.

changes.source: You surely are, brother. We chose you out of dozens of suitable adepts and then we visited you in utmost secrecy to charge you with the investigation of the case of the merchant Ollmier. We wanted to contact you after some time and take over the result of your investigation, but we couldn't. Our allies started to die one after another, usually very violently, and we figured out the enemy was after us. We didn't want to endanger you, hence we left you to your own fate and hoped you would manage to survive even without our help and maybe eventually get here to Alvaron to help us to step in against the conspirators.
changes.before: 你说得不错，兄弟。我们从数十名合适的信徒中挑选了你，随后极度隐秘地登门造访，委托你调查商人奥尔米尔一案。我们本打算过些时日再与你接头、接过你查出的结果，却没能做到。我们的盟友开始一个接一个地死去，死状往往极为惨烈，我们这才明白敌人正在追猎我们。我们不愿连累你，于是任由你自求生路，盼着你即便没有我们的相助也能活下来，甚至最终来到阿尔瓦伦，帮我们出手对付那些阴谋家。

changes.source: Your life is forfeit, Seneschal. But your soul has hope for salvation. Make confession. Open your soul to God and admit your sins. As you can see, the infernal powers have forsaken you. They've let you to fall and haven't helped you. But God may forgive you. Don't deprive yourself of the chance of eternal life!

changes.source: No, certainly not. I'm just surprised by the priest asking the knight of the Brotherhood of the Righteous about the Fallen Angels. But to answer your question—the Holy Scriptures mention the Fallen Angels as the most dreadful servants of the Dark Prince of Hell. They are former angels, struck by God's punishment for their sins when they along with Satan the Tempter plotted treason against God Almighty at the dawn of days. Since then they have been trying to get back to seize rule over the world and over Heaven. They are four—Arthamon, Lord of the defeat, Baphomet, the master of madness, Cerdie, the wanton succubus, and the Archangel Azrael, the devil's emissary and evil's advocate. Lots of lesser demons and infernal henchmen serve them and the Fallen Angels send them to the world to cause harm and to sow seeds of ruin and disruption.
changes.before: 不，当然不是。我只是有些惊讶——一位牧师竟向正义兄弟会的骑士打听堕落天使的事。不过回答你的问题——圣典中记载，堕落天使是地狱暗王子最可怖的仆从。他们本是天使，在太初之时与诱惑者撒旦密谋背叛全能的上帝，因罪孽遭受天罚而堕落。自那以后，他们一直企图重返天界，夺取对人间和天堂的统治。他们共有四个——战败之主阿尔萨蒙、疯狂之主巴弗默、放荡的魅魔塞尔迪，以及大天使阿兹瑞尔——恶魔使者、邪恶的代言人。众多低等恶魔和地狱爪牙为他们效力，堕落天使将这些爪牙派往人间，制造祸害，播撒毁灭与动荡的种子。

changes.source: You surely are, sir. We chose you out of dozens of suitable adepts and then we visited you in utmost secrecy to charge you with the investigation of the case of the merchant Ollmier. We wanted to contact you after some time and take over the result of your investigation, but we couldn't. Our allies started to die one after another, usually very violently, and we figured out the enemy was after us. We didn't want to endanger you, hence we left you to your own fate and hoped you would manage to survive even without our help and maybe eventually get here to Alvaron to help us to step in against the conspirators.
changes.before: 您确实是，先生。我们从数十名合适的人选中挑选了您，然后极其隐秘地前去拜访您，委托您调查商人奥尔米尔的案件。我们本想过段时间再联系您，取回您调查的结果，但没能做到。我们的盟友开始一个接一个地死去，通常都极其惨烈，我们意识到敌人已经盯上了我们。我们不愿连累您，便任由您自行求生，希望您即使没有我们的帮助也能活下来，甚至最终来到阿尔瓦伦，帮助我们出面对抗阴谋者。

changes.source: I represent a group of royalists, sir, sworn to defend the Realm against any danger, be it from the outside or from the inside, even if it would cost them their lives. We are wholly devoted to the Crown and everything we do is in its best interest. Several years ago we were many, but many of our supporters have died recently. In fact only a few of us are left and consequently we cannot keep our influence even in Alvaron, the capital of the Realm! Contrary to our enemies—by all accounts, their numbers have been rising all the time. We don't know which group of heretics it is, but their contacts reach into the highest circles of society, there's no doubt about that.
changes.before: 我代表一个保王派团体，先生，他们誓言捍卫王国免受任何威胁，无论来自外部还是内部，哪怕付出生命也在所不惜。我们全身心效忠于王冠，所做的一切皆是为王冠着想。数年前我们人多势众，但许多支持者近来已经死去。事实上我们只剩下寥寥数人，因此连在王国首都阿尔瓦伦都无法维持影响力！而我们的敌人却恰恰相反——据各方情报，他们的势力一直在壮大。我们不知道那究竟是哪个异端团体，但他们的关系网已渗透进社会最高层，这一点毫无疑问。

changes.source: Hans von Drichtmaul runs his famous armory in Glatzburg. He makes really great stuff—I bought some of his specials myself. Wisewoman Enrie Jungwirdt and the alchemist Paolus Ventimus can provide you with potions and various magic goods. The innkeeper Wanda Gielwitch and the landlord Ludwig Weintraum offer various wares. Last but not least, I like shopping at Alphonso DiCerbio's best. You can buy there almost anything... of course if you don't mind from where he got the goods.

changes.source: You want to hear the story of my life? Well, sit down then—it's going to be a long story. It all started when I was at the dangerous age, knight. You know, when you start liking girls and you feel like the king of the world thinking nothing can ever happen to you. Well, something happened to me. I was caught by Baron Trow von Ulbracht having fun with his only daughter in a barn. He got furious and it almost cost me my life. He started yelling that I had dishonored his only daughter, slashing his sword around so violently that he almost hit his naughty daughter. I managed to run away to my village but the next day the Baron came, resolved to have me executed. Things were getting tough—as the son of a poor peasant I had no means of defending myself so I took the only chance I had at the time. I joined the party of Paul Wachthremm. At the time, he believed he would be the person to free the Holy Grave of the First Prophet from the dirty pagan hands of the Jad-Habaal Empire and answered Pope Pius' call for a crusade. I accepted the cross and ended up in the Duke's army.
changes.before: 你想听我的生平故事？那就坐下吧——这可是一段漫长的故事。一切都始于我身处危险年纪的时候，骑士。你知道的，就是开始喜欢姑娘、觉得自己是世界之王、以为什么灾祸都不会降临到你头上的年纪。嗯，灾祸确实落到了我头上。我被特罗·冯·乌尔布拉赫特男爵当场撞见，正在谷仓里和他的独女厮混。他勃然大怒，我差点为此送命。他大喊说我玷污了他的独女，挥剑乱砍，险些砍到他那不检点的女儿。我好不容易逃回村里，可第二天男爵就来了，决意要将我处死。形势越来越严峻——我不过是个穷农民的儿子，无力为自己辩护，于是抓住了当时唯一的机会。我加入了保罗·瓦赫特雷姆的队伍。那时，他相信自己将是把先知圣墓从贾德-哈巴尔帝国肮脏的异教徒手中解放出来的人，于是响应了庇护教皇的十字军号召。我接受了十字，最终进入了公爵的军队。

changes.source: We marched across the whole Realm to Alvaron, where I and a thousand others boarded a ship which took us to the Kingdoms of Calmariland. There we joined King Bert of Tenerick's army and marched to the holy mountain Estroppel at the borders of the Empire. It was here that Pope Pius the Sixth personally performed a mass blessing all the crusaders and pronouncing us the knights of God. Then I got a sword and some armor. They put me in a saddle and for a couple of months we traveled across the Empire to the borders of the pagan Empire Jad-Habaal. It wasn't a pleasant journey. Some parts of the Empire are a complete wasteland and we were starving so the army was half destroyed before we met the first pagan bastards. I survived though and I saw true hell. Have you ever been to Jad-Habaal, knight? It's a desert. Sand and heat and little shade anywhere. The pagan bastards knew how to survive there but we didn't. The people who died in the last crusade didn't know it and those who died after us didn't figure it out either. It was simply hell.
changes.before: 我们穿越整个王国抵达阿尔瓦伦，在那里我和其他一千人登上一艘船，被送往卡尔马里兰诸王国。我们加入了特内里克国王伯特的军队，向帝国边境的圣山埃斯特罗佩尔进军。正是在那里，庇护教皇第六世亲自主持弥撒，为所有十字军战士祝福，宣告我们为上帝的骑士。随后我得到了一柄剑和一些盔甲。他们把我安置在马鞍上，我们花了几个月穿越帝国，抵达异教帝国贾德-哈巴尔的边境。那不是一段愉快的旅程。帝国的部分地区完全是荒原，我们饥肠辘辘，所以在遭遇第一批异教杂种之前，军队已折损过半。但我活了下来，我见到了真正的地狱。你去过贾德-哈巴尔吗，骑士？那是一片沙漠。沙子、酷热，几乎找不到荫蔽之处。那些异教杂种知道如何在那里生存，但我们不知道。上次十字军东征中死去的人不知道，我们之后死去的人也没能参透。那简直就是地狱。

changes.source: First, the war was going well, I must say. With King Bert of Tenerick, who was already called the Iron King at the time, at the head of the army, we fought our way to Jevaran. We managed to conquer it after several months and thus we freed the Holy Grave of the First Prophet. At that time we thought nothing could stop us and nothing could stop the victory of the true faith over the pagans. So we went on to the center of Jad-Habaal. The pagans would only send small untrained units who didn't stand a chance against our cavalry. We were crushing them under the hooves of our horses and conquering miles. We defeated some of their cities and many strongholds and we were positive the final victory was at hand. But, we were awfully wrong. After conquering Nafrat we found out about a huge army of pagans coming from the south. Before we could do anything we were cut off. The land we had conquered. including Jevaran, fell back to the hands of pagans and we were under siege in Nafrat. The three years I spent there made me thirty years older, knight. The situation was desperate. We were able to hold the walls but the numbers of the Jad-Habaal bastards were infinite. It was like looking at an endless sea.
changes.before: 首先，我得说，战争进行得很顺利。特内里克国王伯特——当时已被称作铁王——率领大军，我们一路杀到杰瓦兰。数月之后我们终于攻陷了它，从而解放了先知圣墓。那时我们以为没有什么能阻挡我们，没有什么能阻止真正信仰对异教徒的胜利。于是我们继续深入贾德-哈巴尔腹地。异教徒只派出小股未经训练的部队，在我们的骑兵面前毫无胜算。我们将他们踩在马蹄之下，一里又一里地攻城略地。我们攻破了他们的数座城池和诸多要塞，坚信最终胜利已近在眼前。但我们大错特错了。攻占纳夫拉特之后，我们得知一支庞大的异教军队正从南方逼近。还没等我们做出反应，退路便被切断了。我们攻占的土地。包括杰瓦兰，重新落入异教徒之手，而我们被困在纳夫拉特，遭到围困。我在那里度过的三年，让我老了三十岁，骑士。局势岌岌可危。我们还能守住城墙，但贾德-哈巴尔杂种的数量无穷无尽。就像望着一片无边无际的大海。

changes.source: Of course, knight. As a truly faithful person, I did everything I could to free the Holy Grave of the First Prophet from the hands of the filthy Jad-Habaal pagans. There were terrible fights. The blood was up to our knees sometimes. They were great times full of heroism and brotherly love.

changes.source: You want to hear the story of my life? Well, sit down then—it's going to be a long story. It all started when I was at the dangerous age, Father. You know, when you start liking girls and you feel like the king of the world thinking nothing can ever happen to you. Well, something happened to me. I was caught by Baron Trow von Ulbracht having fun with his only daughter in a barn. He got furious and it almost cost me my life. He started yelling that I had dishonored his only daughter, slashing his sword around so violently that he almost hit his naughty daughter. I managed to run away to my village but the next day the Baron came, resolved to have me executed. Things were getting tough—as the son of a poor peasant I had no means of defending myself so I took the only chance I had at the time. I joined the party of Paul Wachthremm. At the time, he believed he would be the person to free the Holy Grave of the First Prophet from the dirty pagan hands of the Jad-Habaal Empire and answered Pope Pius' call for a crusade. I accepted the cross and ended up in the Duke's army.

changes.source: You want to hear the story of my life? Well, sit down then—it's going to be a long story. It all started when I was at the dangerous age, noble sir. You know, when you start liking girls and you feel like the king of the world thinking nothing can ever happen to you. Well, something happened to me. I was caught by Baron Trow von Ulbracht having fun with his only daughter in a barn. He got furious and it almost cost me my life. He started yelling that I had dishonored his only daughter, slashing his sword around so violently that he almost hit his naughty daughter. I managed to run away to my village but the next day the Baron came, resolved to have me executed. Things were getting tough—as the son of a poor peasant I had no means of defending myself so I took the only chance I had at the time. I joined the party of Paul Wachthremm. At the time, he believed he would be the person to free the Holy Grave of the First Prophet from the dirty pagan hands of the Jad-Habaal Empire and answered Pope Pius' call for a crusade. I accepted the cross and ended up in the Duke's army.
changes.before: 你想听我这一生的故事？那就坐下吧——这故事可长着呢。一切要从我年少轻狂的时候说起，老爷。你知道的，就是那种开始喜欢姑娘、自以为是天下之王、觉得世上没人能把你怎么样的年纪。可偏偏，我出事了。我在谷仓里和特罗·冯·乌尔布拉赫特男爵的独生女厮混，被他当场撞见。他勃然大怒，差点要了我的命。他大喊我玷污了他的独生女，挥剑乱砍，险些劈到他那不检点的女儿身上。我好不容易逃回村子，可第二天男爵就找上门来，一心要置我于死地。情势危急——作为穷佃农的儿子，我毫无自保之力，只好抓住当时唯一的出路。我加入了保罗·瓦赫特雷姆的队伍。那时他坚信自己就是那个能将先知圣墓从贾德-哈巴尔帝国肮脏的异教徒手中解放出来的人，并响应了庇护教皇的十字军号召。我领受了十字，最终进了公爵的军队。

changes.source: First, the war was going well, I must say. With King Bert of Tenerick, who was already called the Iron King at the time, at the head of the army, we fought our way to Jevaran. We managed to conquer it after several months and thus we freed the Holy Grave of the First Prophet. At that time we thought nothing could stop us and nothing could stop the victory of the true faith over the pagans. So we went on to the center of Jad-Habaal. The pagans would only send small untrained units who didn't stand a chance against our cavalry. We were crushing them under the hooves of our horses and conquering miles. We defeated some of their cities and many strongholds and we were positive the final victory was at hand. But, we were awfully wrong. After conquering Nafrat we found out about a huge army of pagans coming from the south. Before we could do anything we were cut off. The land we had conquered. including Jevaran, fell back to the hands of pagans and we were under siege in Nafrat. The three years I spent there made me thirty years older, noble sir. The situation was desperate. We were able to hold the walls but the numbers of the Jad-Habaal bastards were infinite. It was like looking at an endless sea.
changes.before: 起初，战事进展顺利，这话我必须承认。以特内里克国王伯特——那时他已被称为铁王——为首的军队一路杀到杰瓦兰。经过数月苦战，我们终于将其攻下，先知圣墓由此解放。那时我们以为没有任何东西能阻挡我们，也没有任何东西能阻止真信仰对异教徒的胜利。于是我们继续深入贾德-哈巴尔腹地。异教徒只会派出零星的散兵游勇，在我们的骑兵面前毫无胜算。我们纵马踏碎他们，一寸寸攻城略地。我们攻下了他们的一些城池和诸多要塞，坚信最终胜利就在眼前。但我们大错特错。攻陷纳夫拉特之后，我们获悉一支庞大的异教大军正从南方扑来。还没等我们做出反应，退路就被截断了。我们征服的土地——包括杰瓦兰——重新落入异教徒之手，而我们被困在纳夫拉特城里。我在那里度过的三年，让我一下子老了三十岁，老爷。局势已至绝境。城墙我们还守得住，可贾德-哈巴尔的杂兵多得无穷无尽，一眼望去，如同无边无际的大海。

changes.source: If you want to sell or buy weapons or armor, just visit Hans von Drichtmaul in his armory shop. Wisewoman Enrie Jungwirdt and the alchemist Paolus Ventimus can provide you with potions and magic goods. The innkeeper Wanda Gielwitch and the landlord Ludwig Weintraum offer various wares. Well, and Alphonso DiCerbio will also sell you almost anything—if you don't mind the origin of his wares.

changes.source: Woe, knight! The visions of the Fallen Angels haunt me in my dreams these days... Surely it is not by chance that you're asking. The Archangel Gabriel himself came to me in my dream and prophesized terrible news. The judgment is at hand—the inevitable is coming. I fell upon my knees in my dream and then I saw the Earth crack open—infernal flames burst out revealing the three Fallen Angels—Arthamon, the ruler of despair and the cursed lord of fire; Baphomet, the demon of madness and the creator of chaos; and Cerdie, the lascivious mistress of fornication and of eternal sin. And the world was flooded with beasts and monsters dancing gruesome dance celebrating the end of the millennium lasting Kingdom of God on Earth. The fallen angels rose and the earth and the heavens trembled under the blast of their infernal powers. And then came despair and chaos and all the people were drown in eternal sin. The end of all things came. Kingdoms were crumbling, people were fornicating, murdering, dying... and the False Prophet was walking the Earth demonically laughing.
changes.before: 祸哉，骑士！这些日子，堕落天使的幻象在我的梦中缠绕不休……你来询问绝非偶然。大天使加百列亲自来到我的梦中，预言了可怕的消息。审判已在眼前——不可避免之事正在降临。我在梦中跪倒在地，随后我看见大地裂开——地狱烈焰喷涌而出，显露出三位堕落天使——阿尔萨蒙，绝望的主宰与被诅咒的火焰之主；巴弗灭，疯狂的恶魔与混沌的创造者；以及瑟迪，淫欲与永恒罪孽的放荡女主人。世界被野兽与怪物淹没，它们跳着可怖的舞蹈，庆祝那延续千年的人间神国的终结。堕落天使们升起，大地与苍穹在他们地狱之力的冲击下震颤。随后绝望与混沌降临，所有人都沉沦于永恒的罪孽之中。万物走到了尽头。王国分崩离析，人们行淫、杀戮、死去……而伪先知行走于大地之上，发出恶魔般的笑声。

changes.source: The Children of the New Order? Yes, I know who they are. They were acting in the dark ages at the end of the Hundred Years War, that's in the tenth century. They were led by certain Lucius—he was a Dark Prophet and the High Priest of the cult. That was him who prophesized the end of the Kingdom of God on Earth and the release of Satan from his prison. He was preaching about the end of the Old World and about coming of a New Order—Its children were supposed to rule the enthralled souls of the righteous who were to be killed by sword and fire in the process. Although the cult infiltrated the highest social ranks of the Empire it met a gruesome end. All the cultists—including Lucius—were executed. Burnt. And that was their end.
changes.before: 新秩序之子？是的，我知道他们。他们在百年战争末期的黑暗时代活动，也就是十世纪。他们由一个名叫卢修斯的人领导——他是暗黑先知，也是该教团的至高牧师。正是他预言了人间神国的终结，以及撒旦从囚禁中被释放。他宣扬旧世界的末日，以及新秩序的降临——其子嗣本应统治正义者被蛊惑的灵魂，而这些人将死于刀剑与烈焰之下。尽管该教团渗透进了帝国最高的社会阶层，但最终仍落得一个可怖的下场。所有教徒——包括卢修斯——全被处死。被活活烧死。那便是他们的结局。

changes.source: Son, you're a hopeless case it seems. You've been investigating the greatest case of heresy and conspiracy in the history of the Realm and now when you discover the main culprit you have no idea what it was all about. Anyway, I'm going to explain it to you because I want to ask you a single question which you wouldn't be able to answer without comprehending everything. Very well—the summoning of the Fallen Angels mentioned in the Plan of the Dark Prophet Lucius was not intended to bring their physical projection into our world but rather to invoke the infernal powers they represent. That means Satan will be summoned regardless of the physical presence of Arthamon, Baphomet or Cerdie in our world—the only thing that matters are their infernal powers. And those have been irrecoverably unleashed! Just look around and tell me, do your really think that there's still the Kingdom of God on Earth as described by the Holy Scriptures? I don't think so—just the contrary. I can see only mortal sins—one alongside another. People are killing each other, they're given to fits of rage and are fornicating with each other regardless of law or order. That's what I call Hell!
changes.before: 孩子，看来你真是无可救药了。你一直在调查王国历史上最大规模的异端与阴谋案，如今终于挖出了主谋，却对这一切的来龙去脉一无所知。不过，我还是会向你解释清楚，因为我要问你一个问题——若你不明白这一切，便无法回答。很好——暗黑先知卢修斯的计划中提到的召唤堕落天使，并非为了将他们的实体投影带到我们的世界，而是为了唤起他们所代表的地狱之力。这意味着，无论阿尔萨蒙、巴风特或瑟迪是否以实体存在于我们的世界，撒旦都会被召唤——唯一重要的是他们的地狱之力。而那些力量已经不可挽回地释放出来了！环顾四周，告诉我，你真的认为圣典所描述的人间神国还存在吗？我可不这么认为——恰恰相反。我只看到致命的罪孽——接二连三。人们互相残杀，动辄暴怒失控，无视律法秩序淫乱苟合。这就是我所说的地狱！

changes.source: No, my son—that's brilliant! You'll see for yourself real soon. As you can see, the Dark Prophet Lucius planned and prepared everything to the tiniest detail—of course with the assistance from the Fallen Archangel Azrael. All that needed to be done was to wait for the right moment. The Holy Scripture, the Revelation of Saint Ezekiel—to be more specific, says that Satan will be released from his prison after a thousand years. Of course it's a nonsense which was introduced by Ezekiel's imagination, or better to say by delirium tremens caused by unrestrained drinking. Nevertheless, common people were influenced greatly. As soon as the year 1223 started to loom, people began to be scared of the end of the world, because they believed that the beginning of the God's Kingdom on Earth dated back to 223 when the pagan Empire of Ereborn fell and faithful kingdoms were born. Of course that's nonsense as well. Well, but it was an opportunity we could not just let go!

changes.source: I don't think that I, as the head of the Holy Mother Church of the Ultherst Nation, would be the most competent to inform you about heretical cults—it's the mission of the inquisitors, isn't it? Nevertheless I know the name, of course. It was a cult which originated in the Empire in the 10th century. According to rumors it was founded by a certain Lucius; a self-proclaimed Dark Prophet. He prognosticated the end of the world and the birth of a new order—its children were supposed to rule the world by the side of the Lord of Darkness himself. The danger of the cult lay in its ability to permeate all social strata and to infect even the highest ranks of the Church and the nobility of the Empire. Nevertheless, the papal Holy Office managed to discover the heretics in the end and they were all executed in 1021, including Lucius. Then the cult perished and there has been no word about it since.

That means Satan will be summoned regardless of the physical presence of Arthamon, Baphomet or Cerdie in our world—the only thing that matters are their infernal powers. And those have been irrecoverably unleashed! Just look around and tell me, do your really think that there's still the Kingdom of God on Earth as described by the Holy Scriptures? I don't think so—just the contrary. I can see only mortal sins—one alongside another. People are killing each other, they're giving to fits of rage and are fornicating with each other regardless of law or order. That's what I call Hell!

changes.source: No, my son—that's brilliant! You'll see for yourself real soon. As you can see, the Dark Prophet Lucius planned and prepared everything to the tiniest detail—of course with the assistance from the Fallen Archangel Azrael. All that needed to be done was to wait for the right moment. The Holy Scripture, the Revelation of Saint Ezekiel—to be more specific, says that Satan will be released from his prison after thousand years. Of course it's a nonsense which was introduced by Ezekiel's imagination, or better to say by delirium tremens caused by unrestrained drinking. Nevertheless, common people were influenced greatly. As soon as the year 1223 started to loom, people began to be scared of the end of the world, because they believed that the beginning of God's Kingdom on Earth dated back to 223 when the pagan Empire of Ereborn fell and faithful kingdoms were born. Of course that's nonsense as well. But it was an opportunity we could not just let go!
changes.before: 不，我的孩子——这太妙了！你很快就会亲眼看到。如你所见，暗黑先知卢修斯把一切计划得滴水不漏、准备得面面俱到——当然，这全靠堕落大天使阿兹瑞尔的协助。剩下的，不过是等待合适的时机。《圣典》——《圣以西结启示录》，更确切地说——写道，撒旦将在千年后从囚禁中被释放。当然，这纯属胡言乱语，是西结凭空臆想出来的，或者更确切地说，是无节制饮酒导致的震颤谵妄的产物。尽管如此，平民百姓却深受其影响。当1223年渐渐逼近，人们开始惧怕世界末日，因为他们相信人间神国始于223年——那一年，异教的埃雷博恩帝国覆灭，虔信的王国由此诞生。当然，这也是胡说八道。但这正是我们不能轻易放过的机会！

changes.source: I doubt I could tell you anything new about the Fallen Angels, my son. I'm sure you know that the Fallen Angels are the most terrible servants of the Dark ruler of Hell. They are former angels stricken by divine punishment for their sins, they were, together with Satan the Tempter, plotting betrayal against God Almighty at the dawn of time. The Holy Scriptures say that they were cast down from Heaven to be bound in Hell to suffer there for their sins. Since then they've been trying to get back so that they could rule both Earth and Heaven. There are four of them, Arthamon, the Lord of Despair, Baphomet, the Ruler of Madness, Cerdie, the Vile Succubus, and the Archangel Azrael, the advocate of Evil and the Satan's emissary.
changes.before: 关于堕落天使，我恐怕说不出什么新鲜事了，我的孩子。我相信你知道，堕落天使是地狱暗黑统治者最可怕的仆从。他们是因罪孽遭受神罚而堕落的昔日天使，早在太初之时，他们便与诱惑者撒旦一同密谋背叛全能的上帝。《圣典》记载，他们被逐出天堂，囚禁于地狱之中，为自己的罪孽受苦。自那时起，他们一直试图重返人间与天堂，以便同时统治尘世与天界。共有四位：绝望之主阿尔萨蒙、疯狂之君巴弗灭、卑劣的魅魔瑟尔迪，以及大天使阿兹瑞尔——邪恶的鼓吹者、撒旦的使者。

changes.source: I don't think that I, as the head of the Holy Mother Church of the Ultherst Nation, would be the most competent to inform you about heretical cults, it's the mission of the inquisitors, isn't it? Nevertheless I know the name, of course. It was a cult which originated in the Empire in the 10th century. According to rumors it was founded by certain Lucius; a self-proclaimed Dark Prophet. He prognosticated the end of the world and the birth of a new order, its children were supposed to rule the world by the side of the Lord of Darkness himself. The danger of the cult lay in its ability to permeate all social strata and to infect even the highest ranks of the Church and the nobility of the Empire. Nonetheless, the papal Holy Office managed to discover the heretics in the end and they were all executed in 1021, including Lucius. Then the cult perished and there has been no word about it since.
changes.before: 作为乌尔瑟斯民族圣母教会的领袖，我认为自己并非向你介绍异端邪教的最合适人选——那本是审判官的使命，不是吗？不过，这个名字我当然知道。那是一个十世纪起源于帝国的邪教。据传，它由一个名叫卢修斯的人创立，此人自封为暗黑先知。他预言了世界末日与新秩序的诞生，其子嗣本应与黑暗之主本人并肩统治世界。该邪教的危险之处在于，它能渗透所有社会阶层，甚至感染教会高层与帝国贵族。然而，教宗的圣务院最终还是查出了这些异端，他们于1021年全部被处决，卢修斯亦在其中。此后该邪教便已消亡，再无音讯。

changes.source: We've already talked about Jean de Guise, the seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, son. I must express again my sorrow about the matter—the situation his treachery led us into and the fact that so many people perished because of his betrayal are grave indeed. I hope we will be able to judge the heretic as soon as possible and at least partly rectify the damage he committed!
changes.before: 孩子，我们已经谈过正义兄弟会的家宰让·德·吉斯了。我必须再次表达对此事的痛心——他的背叛把我们推入了何等境地，又有多少人因他而丧生，这一切实在沉重。但愿我们能尽快审判这名异端，至少部分弥补他所犯下的罪过！

changes.source: A letter from Grand Master de Malamert, you say? Show it to me, I'll look at it. Well... the seal doesn't seem broken and this really is the handwriting of Grand Master de Malamert... But the things he writes here... Good Heavens... this is... terrible! The Cult of the Children of the New Order? Invocation of the Fallen Angels? Releasing Satan from his underground prison?! Jean de Guise a traitor? Let the Archangel Gabriel protect us from such evil! This is the worst news I've ever heard. I'm sorry, son, for not trusting you at first. But if you knew the situation here in Alvaron a bit, you would agree with me that one can't be cautious enough these days. Especially in the case if all you found out during your investigation, as I've just read in Grand Master de Malamert's letter, is true...
changes.before: 你说这是德·马拉梅特大团长的信？拿给我看看吧。嗯……封印似乎没有破损，这确实是德·马拉梅特大团长的笔迹……可他信上写的这些事……天哪……这简直……太可怕了！新秩序之子教团？召唤堕天使？把撒旦从地下囚牢中释放出来？！让·德·吉斯是叛徒？愿大天使加百列庇佑我们免遭此等邪祟！这是我听过最糟糕的消息。抱歉，孩子，我一开始不该怀疑你。但你若对阿尔瓦伦的局势略知一二，就会同意我的看法——如今这世道，再怎么谨慎都不为过。尤其是倘若你在调查中查明的一切，正如我刚刚从德·马拉梅特大团长信中读到的，确有其事……

changes.source: Because he had a book we needed for the preparation of the summoning ritual. I killed him to cover all the tracks. Nobody was to know what book we gained from him. And beyond that, the fool wanted to extort me! He said that the Inquisition would be surely interested in what books I was interested. He wanted my body; he wanted to fornicate with me. But I didn't grant him that pleasure. I killed him.
changes.before: 因为他手里有一本我们准备召唤仪式时需要的书。我杀了他，是为了抹去一切痕迹——绝不能让任何人知道我们从他那里得到了什么书。更何况，那个蠢货还想敲扎我！他说宗教裁判所一定会对我在看什么书很感兴趣。他想要我的身体；他想与我交媾。但我没有给他这份乐趣。我杀了他。

changes.after: 总管让·德·吉斯。

changes.source: Yes, I was sure about it. Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of our Order, my long-time companion in arms and a true friend. It was he who visited you together with me that spring. We decided to entrust you with that case of the murder of the merchant Kurth Ollmier because we knew the enemy was watching us. We couldn't afford to address the matter ourselves because we'd show the enemy that way how much we knew and where our steps were headed. For you the situation was completely different, brother. Nobody knew you; nobody could know what you plan and what were you going to do. Exactly because of that we entrusted you with the case. The only thing I don't understand is why you have come in bad faith instead of joining our forces and trying to stop the enemy whom you probably know better than me now...
changes.before: 是的，我确信是他。让·德·吉斯，我们正义兄弟会的家宰，我多年的老战友，真正的朋友。那个春天与我一同拜访你的人，正是他。我们决定将商人库尔特·奥尔米尔的谋杀案托付给你，因为我们知道敌人正在监视我们。我们不能亲自处理此事，否则便会向敌人暴露我们所知多少、将要走向何方。对你而言，情况则完全不同，兄弟。没有人认识你；没有人能知晓你的计划与行动。正因如此，我们才将此案交给你。我唯一不明白的是，你为何怀着恶意而来，而不是与我们合力，设法阻止那个如今你或许比我更了解的敌人……

changes.source: Jean de Guise introduced himself to me as the man who had visited me in the beginning of this spring and had entrusted me with the investigation of Kurth Ollmier's death. The Seneschal also told me that he believes you are a member of some plot aiming to disrupt the Realm and gave me the proof that I put forward to the Supreme Tribunal of the Inquisition. The tribunal accused you of heresy and ordered to arrest you.
changes.before: 让·德·吉斯向我自称，他就是初春时节拜访我、将库尔特·奥尔米尔之死的调查托付于我的那个人。这位家宰还告诉我，他相信您是一个旨在颠覆王国的阴谋的成员，并交给我证据，由我呈交宗教裁判所最高审判庭。审判庭据此指控您犯有异端罪，下令将您逮捕。

changes.source: All of that is true, brother. Except for one thing—I'm the head of those royalists, not Seneschal Jean de Guise! He tricked me... betrayed me. He dishonored our Order. There's no doubt about it now. He's the traitor—I've been suspecting for some time that there's a traitor among us. It was him who revealed all our plans to the enemy and who betrayed the names of our helpers. He's guilty of the deaths of a great many people, who were found and slaughtered without mercy. He's the treacherous traitor!

changes.source: At first we thought somebody was trying to get the power in the Realm into his hands through those intrigues. But soon we started to suspect there was more than a political fight here. The smell of brimstone and heresy was to be scented behind the strange events that seemed to happen without a mutual connection. Meanwhile, the Scourges of God affected the Realm and interrupted the investigation of the plot for some time. Unfortunately, the Scourges of God also overwhelmingly influenced our group—many of our members died, the others disappeared without a trace. Too late did I realize it wasn't an accident but the work of plotters who were precisely organized and well prepared. It was obvious they got to know about us, even though I'm still shocked to realize that it was Seneschal Jean de Guise who betrayed our plans to the enemy and informed him about our comrades. Simply put, the enemy knew everything about us and we knew almost nothing about him.
changes.before: 起初，我们以为有人想通过这些阴谋将王国的权力攫取于手中。但很快，我们开始怀疑这其中不仅仅是政治斗争。那些看似毫无关联的怪异事件背后，弥漫着硫磺与异端的气息。与此同时，神罚灾难席卷王国，使对阴谋的调查一度中断。不幸的是，神罚灾难也重创了我们的团体——许多成员因此丧命，其余的则消失得无影无踪。我意识到这并非意外，而是那些组织严密、准备充分的阴谋者所为时，为时已晚。显然他们已经知道了我们的存在，尽管我至今仍震惊地发现，正是管家让·德·吉斯将我们的计划出卖给了敌人，并向其告发了我们的同伴。简言之，敌人对我们了如指掌，而我们对敌人几乎一无所知。

changes.source: That's a great news, brother. It's better than I hoped. Those letters are straight proof against a high-ranking member of the Cult. I'm sure they'll help us to find the Dark High Priest himself. But first of all we must find out who wrote those letters. I know one man here in Alvaron who could help us with this problem. The priest Marcius, Archbishop's scribe and illuminator, knows well the handwriting of all the members of Archbishop's diocese including Inquisitor General, Cardinal Commendoni, and most of the nobles of the Realm sitting in the Royal Court. If the author of the letters you've found belongs to these people, Father Marcius will surely recognize his handwriting.
changes.before: 这是个好消息，兄弟。比我期望的还要好。那些信件是指控邪教一名高层成员的铁证。我确信它们能帮我们找到黑暗大祭司本人。但首先，我们必须查明这些信是谁写的。我知道阿尔瓦伦有一个人能帮我们解决这个问题。马尔修斯神父，大主教的书记与泥金装饰师，对大主教教区内所有成员的笔迹都了如指掌，其中包括审判官长科门多尼枢机主教，以及王国在王室宫廷中列席的大多数贵族。如果你找到的信件出自这些人之手，马尔修斯神父必定能认出他的笔迹。

changes.source: Thank you, brother. Unfortunately, I can't help you much with your investigations because my hands are bound by the accusation that was brought against me. But if I could advise you in any way, don't hesitate to turn to me. You'll always find me here in the Citadel, the ancient seat of our Order. It's probably the only safe place where I can take shelter. Furthermore you can always approach Cardinal Gustapho Letti—he's my trusted friend and ally standing by my side from the very beginning. I believe firmly I'm not mistaken in him as I was in Jean de Guise. Give him this letter in which I explain all in detail. And one last thing—if Seneschal Jean de Guise asked you about the progress of the investigation of my person, don't tell him about our meeting and say I'm still avoiding you. We'll circumvent unnecessary troubles this way...
changes.before: 谢谢你，兄弟。遗憾的是，我无法在你的调查中帮上多少忙，因为针对我的指控把我的双手束缚住了。但若我还能给你什么建议，尽管来找我。你总能在城堡要塞找到我——我们兄弟会的古老驻地。这大概是我唯一能藏身的安全之所了。此外，你随时可以去找古斯塔福·莱蒂枢机主教——他是我信任的朋友与盟友，自始至终站在我这边。我坚信自己这次不会看错他，就像我当初看错让·德·吉斯那样。把这封信交给他，我在信中已详述一切。最后还有一件事——如果管家让·德·吉斯向你打听对我本人的调查进展，不要告诉他我们见过面，只说我仍在躲着你。这样我们就能避开不必要的麻烦……

changes.source: I'll be glad to appoint you a Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, brother. I hope you're sufficiently ready for the task I have to assign to you as a test. I won't hide that it will be a very demanding task. You'll have to clarify the murder of His Majesty King Edward II. If you manage to find his murderer and prove your exceptional bravery by killing more than half a thousand hellspawns, you'll become a Seneschal of the Order.

changes.source: Yes, I was sure about it. Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of our Order, my long-time companion in arms and a true friend. It was he who visited you together with me that spring. We decided to entrust you with that case of the murder of the merchant Kurth Ollmier because we knew the enemy was watching us. We couldn't afford to address the matter ourselves because we'd show the enemy that way how much we knew and where our steps were headed. For you the situation was completely different, Father. Nobody knew you; nobody could know what you plan and what were you going to do. Exactly because of that we entrusted you with the case. The only thing I don't understand is why you have come in bad faith instead of joining our forces and trying to stop the enemy whom you probably know better than me now...

changes.source: Yes, I was sure about it. Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of our Order, my long-time companion in arms and a true friend. It was he who visited you together with me that spring. We decided to entrust you with that case of the murder of the merchant Kurth Ollmier because we knew the enemy was watching us. We couldn't afford to address the matter ourselves because we'd show the enemy that way how much we knew and where our steps were headed. For you the situation was completely different, sir. Nobody knew you; nobody could know what you plan and what were you going to do. Exactly because of that we entrusted you with the case. The only thing I don't understand is why you have come in bad faith instead of joining our forces and trying to stop the enemy whom you probably know better than me now...
changes.before: 是的，我对此确信无疑。让·德·吉斯，我们兄弟会的家宰，我多年来的战友与挚友。那年春天，与我一同前来拜访您的正是他。我们决定把商人库尔特·奥尔米尔的谋杀案托付给您，因为我们知道敌人正在监视我们。我们不能亲自处理此事，那样做等于向敌人暴露我们究竟知道多少、又将去往何方。而对您来说，情况则完全不同，大人。没有人认识您；也没有人能知道您的计划、您将要做什么。正因如此，我们才把这件案子托付给您。我唯一不明白的是，您为何心怀恶意而来，而不是与我们合力，设法阻止那个敌人——如今您对他的了解，或许已胜过我了……

changes.source: All of that is true, sir. Except for one thing—I'm the head of those royalists, not Seneschal Jean de Guise! He tricked me... betrayed me. He dishonored our Order. There's no doubt about it now. He's the traitor—I've been suspecting for some time that there's a traitor among us. It was him who revealed all our plans to the enemy and who betrayed the names of our helpers. He's guilty of the deaths of a great many people, who were found and slaughtered without mercy. He's the treacherous traitor!

changes.source: People say there is a horrible stryx lurking at the city cemetery, born from a cursed girl named Joan. The legend says Joan was cursed by her own mother, who was a nun of the order of Saint Bethesda, violated by some goatish priest. She lost her mind then and wandered the realm aimlessly until she gave birth to her daughter at the Alvaron cemetery.
changes.before: 有人说城外墓地潜伏着一只可怖的斯特里克斯，它诞生于一个名叫琼的被诅咒的少女。传说琼被自己的母亲诅咒——她母亲原是圣贝塞斯达修会的修女，被某个淫邪的牧师玷污。此后她便疯了，在王国中漫无目的地游荡，直到在阿尔瓦伦墓地产下女儿。

changes.source: It was my master, Seneschal Jean de Guise. Only he was kind to me, he gave me helping hand and told me comforting words. Only he saw me as a powerful man, a man able to do everything others may do, and not only as a cripple hobbling around. He offered me to enter his service—and being in his strong loving embrace I was told about the secrets of the Cult. And I helped him in everything he wanted me to.
changes.before: 是我的主人，管家让·德·吉斯。只有他对我友善，他向我伸出援手，对我说安慰的话语。只有他视我为一个强大的人，一个无所不能的人，而不只是一个跛足蹒跚的残废。他邀请我为他效力——而在他强有力而慈爱的怀抱中，我得知了教团的秘密。而他要我做的每一件事，我都照办了。

changes.source: Who? That's easy. It was that coward Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. He pretends being a brave knight, but in fact he is a wretch unable to look into his own eyes. I'm almost sorry for that poor coward. My stomach rises every time I just think of him. But he paid and so my services were his.
changes.before: 谁？这很简单。就是那个懦夫让·德·吉斯，正义兄弟会的家宰。他装作勇敢的骑士，实际上却是个连自己眼睛都不敢直视的可怜虫。我几乎要为那个可怜的懦夫感到难过了。光是想起他，我就反胃。但他付了钱，所以我的效劳便归他所有。

changes.source: Did you know, knight, that Erebornian lawyers from the school of Severinus struggled to enforce a principle that would ban forcing the defendant to confess using torture? changes.source: A municipal Sheriff always has as much authority as the royal governor gives him—but only in the area of the army administration and of public order. I, for example, take care of the whole garrison here in Alvaron—from supplies to training and recruiting. I also take care of the municipal prison, which is probably what interests you. When you arrest somebody you can imprison him in the local jail with my consent. If you want to rack him, just tell me. But I hope there won't be much torture because I have a lot of work anyway!
changes.before: 地方警长拥有多大权威，全看王室总督授予多少——但仅限于军事管理和公共秩序。就拿我来说，我负责阿尔瓦伦的整个驻军——从物资补给到训练招募。我还掌管市立监狱，这大概才是你关心的。逮捕某人后，经我同意，你可以将他关进本地牢房。若要用拉肢刑架审他，只需告诉我。但我希望审讯别太多，因为我本来就有够多的活儿要干了！

changes.source: No wonder you haven't, my son. It wasn't any of those heretic cults that have appeared in the Realm during last several years. The cult of Children of the New Order was a powerful group of fanatics certain Lucius gathered around himself in 9th century in the Realm. He claimed he was the Dark Prophet who came to reveal the ending of God's Kingdom in the Earth. The cult spread quickly, because the doctrine of Lucius was very captivating. Soon the heretics had many terrible crimes on their conscience, acting in the name of their ruler, the Dark Prince of Hell. But in the end the cult was destroyed and its members burned, all of them at the same time.
changes.before: 你未曾听闻也难怪，我的孩子。这并非近数年来王国境内出现的那些异端教派。新秩序之子教团是一个强大的狂热者团体，由卢修斯于九世纪在王国境内聚集而成。他自称暗黑先知，声称受命来揭示上帝之国在人间的终结。教团迅速蔓延，因为卢修斯的教义极具蛊惑力。不久，这些异端便以他们的统治者——地狱暗王子——之名，犯下了诸多骇人罪行。但最终，教团被摧毁，其成员尽数被焚烧，无一幸免。

Before the Scourges of God struck they would sell it all over the Realm but now the merchants are not willing to risk the loss of such exclusive goods. So it hasn't been possible to purchase for some time here in Glatzburg. I'm sure, however, that Grand Duke Heidrick has a good supply hidden in his cellars.
changes.before: 这是市面上最好的酒，大人。它产自帝国南部地区，再从那里运往首都阿尔瓦伦。神罚灾难降临之前，它在整个王国都有售，但现在商人们不愿冒险损失这种稀有货物。所以在格拉茨堡已经有段时间买不到了。不过我敢肯定，海德里克大公的地窖里一定藏着不少存货。

changes.source: You've probably heard some of the legends about Saint Orthenius people often tell. Something like that Saint Orthenius is going to come down from the Heaven at the head of an army of angels and save the Realm from all the evil, or that his follower will come from the common folks and burn the enemies of the true faith with the flame of divine justice. I don't know what's true about the legends but there is a place near to Alvaron where Saint Orthenius was buried in 223. Until recently it was one of the most sacred pilgrimage destinations and for the last thousand years crowds of the faithful would travel to see the remains of the patron of our Realm. But now...
changes.before: 你大概听过人们常说的那些关于圣奥塞尼乌斯的传说。比如说，圣奥塞尼乌斯将率领天使军团自天而降，把王国从一切邪恶中拯救出来；又说他的追随者将出自平民，以神圣正义之焰焚烧真正信仰的敌人。我不知道这些传说有几分属实，但在阿尔瓦伦附近有一处地方，圣奥塞尼乌斯于223年葬在那里。直到不久以前，它还是最神圣的朝圣地之一，千百年来信众络绎不绝，前来瞻仰我们王国守护圣者的遗骸。可是如今……

If it's weapons or armor, visit Hans von Drichtmaul—he runs the renowned Glatzburg armory. Wisewoman Enrie Jungwirdt and the alchemist Paolus Ventimus can provide you with potions and magic goods. changes.source: Sure I've heard rumors 'bout war, noble lord. I'm a soldier and not too young so I can smell when something's brewing. Nobody's got to tell anything to me. We got the order from Grand Duke Heidrick to be on alert. That means to keep the men in the garrison and be ready to hit the road any moment. We've been also recruiting, though only volunteers so far. Cavalry needs to be replenished so we've been commandeering horses and draft cattle. We've also been trying to fill the granaries with the little we could get hold of. Well, anyway we can't afford to have big expenses, as there's almost nothing to be taxed. All in all that can mean only one thing—a war's coming. Moreover, there's word the First Knight himself should arrive from Alvaron. Don Rodrigo de Velacor, the first marshal of the royal army, is not just someone who'd be treading the Realm without a damn good reason.
changes.before: 当然我听说过关于战争的传言，贵族大人。我是个老兵，年纪也不小了，有什么风声我一嗅就知道。不需要别人来告诉我。我们接到了海德里克大公的命令，进入警戒状态。意思是把人手留在驻军要塞，随时准备开拔。我们也一直在征兵，不过目前只有志愿入伍的。骑兵需要补充，所以我们一直在征用马匹和役畜。我们也尽量把能找到的一点粮食填进粮仓。嗯，总之我们承担不起太大的开销，因为几乎没什么东西可以征税。总而言之，这一切只意味着一件事——战争要来了。况且有消息说，第一骑士本人将从阿尔瓦伦赶来。王室军队的首席元帅罗德里戈·德·维拉科尔阁下，绝不会无缘无故踏足王国。

changes.source: The Cult of the Children of the New Order? That name really does ring a bell with me. If I remember correctly, it was a heretic cult formed and then acting in the Empire during the Hundred Years War. It was just another group of demoniacs—quite wide spread in those times. People turned to demon worshipping during times of the worst indigence—I'd say it resembled the situation in the Realm nowadays. However, the cult was nothing like a league of poor men preaching that everybody can do whatever he wanted. The cult was founded by a certain Lucius who called himself the Dark Prophet and heralded to his followers that the New Order will come and its children will rule the world—by the means of releasing Satan from his imprisonment.
changes.before: 新秩序之子教团？这个名字我确实有些印象。如果我没记错的话，那是百年战争期间在帝国境内形成并活动的一个异端教派。它不过是又一个崇拜恶魔的团体——在那个时代相当普遍。当人们陷入最深重的困顿时，便会转向恶魔崇拜——我认为如今王国的处境与之相似。然而，这个教派绝非一群宣扬"人人皆可为所欲为"的穷苦之人的联盟。教派由一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯所创立，他向追随者宣称新秩序即将降临，其子民将统治世界——方式便是将撒旦从囚禁中释放出来。

changes.source: Well... I didn't want to tell it to you straight because it could make you angry... but I really stole the monstrance. But there was no devilry in it, noble lord, I swear! When I did it I was dead drunk. I made a bet in the inn that I would steal it during the holy service. I don't know what crossed my mind, such bunk... It was because of that wine I drank... I didn't realize it's an absolute idiocy to steal in a church during a mass. And that was the only reason the innkeeper Weintraum saw me doing it. If I had been sober no one would have seen anything.

changes.source: The best weapons and armor are made by Hans von Drichtmaul, knight. He has an armory here—it's renowned near and far. I'd like to become his apprentice and learn all the master knows. He makes beautiful things, knight. But if you need potions, magic items and so on instead of weapons and armor then go to the wise woman Enrie Jungwirdt or to the alchemist Paolus Ventimus. And you may buy various things from the innkeeper Wanda Gielwitch and the landlord Ludwig Weintraum. And the merchant Alphonso DiCerbio may sell you anything you can imagine, although my father says he sells stolen goods and that God will surely punish him soon.

I'd like to become his apprentice and learn all the master knows. He makes beautiful things, noble lord. changes.source: The legend has it that in the year 965 the dark prophet Lucius foretold the end of the God's Earthly kingdom and the advent of the Dark prince, the bloody angel of revenge, who should sit on the Throne of Heaven instead of God himself. The prophecy was based on the wording of the Holy Scriptures, same as many other similar predictions, concretely on the Revelations of Saint Ezekiel—Apocalypse.
changes.before: 据传，965年，暗黑先知卢修斯预言了神的尘世王国的终结，以及黑暗君王的降临——那嗜血的复仇天使将取代神本人，登上天堂王座。这则预言以圣典的经文为依据，与众多类似的预言如出一辙，具体而言，便是依据《圣以西结启示录》——即《启示录》。

changes.source: I'm not surprised in any way by Master Dieter von Gelbendiel saying something like that, my son. One may quite easily doubt the moral qualities of that man. As a knight of the Brotherhood of the Righteous—which is, by the way, a friary order—he should honor all virtues of the clergy, but he decidedly doesn't do so. He's a utilitarian and a careerist, and it led him to intriguing and to trying to get the office of the Seneschal. I've been watching him for years. That's why I'm not surprised he tries to defame me. But I didn't suspect he would go so far in his arrogance as to maintain I plotted some unholy rites!
changes.before: 对于迪特尔·冯·盖尔本迪尔大人说出这样的话，我丝毫不感到意外，我的孩子。那个人的道德品质实在不难令人怀疑。作为正义兄弟会的骑士——顺便说一句，那是一个托钵修士会——他本应恪守神职人员的一切美德，但他显然没有做到。他是个功利之徒、野心之辈，这使他热衷于阴谋钻营，觊觎家宰之位。我观察他已有多年。正因如此，他企图诽谤我并不令我意外。但我未曾料到他狂妄到如此地步，竟敢宣称我在密谋某种亵渎神圣的仪式！

They were demoniacs, worshippers of Satan, gathered in the second half of the tenth century by a certain Lucius who declared himself a Dark Prophet. This Lucius reputedly foretold the end of the God's Earthly Kingdom and the freeing of Satan from his thousand years prison—as the Holy Scriptures tell us in the Apocalypse of Saint Ezekiel.
changes.before: 当真？这可不是好消息。在此之前，我还以为这个教团早已在往昔被彻底摧毁。他们是恶魔的信徒、撒旦的崇拜者，于十世纪下半叶被一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯聚集起来。据说这个卢修斯预言了神的尘世王国的终结，以及撒旦挣脱千年囚禁的时刻——正如圣典中圣以西结启示录所记载的那样。

changes.source: That's commendable, my son, although I must say you've chosen a very dark area for extending your knowledge. The Holy Scriptures say the Fallen Angels are Satan's minions and that they administer his will and corrupt order. They're the architects of sin, the devisers of treason and the eternal tempters. They're Arthamon, the master of Destruction, Baphomet, the ruler of madness, Cerdie, the mother of debauchery and Azrael, the Fallen Archangel and the first emissary of Satan. All four were thrown down from Heaven along with Satan for their crimes against God. God's punishment bound them in the infernal prison. Since then Hell has been their new home and their palace. From there they try to get into our world to dominate it. But they're not going to succeed, because God's Earthly kingdom is protected by the true faith that's like its angelic shield.
changes.before: 值得称赞，我的孩子，尽管我必须说你为增长见识选择了一个相当黑暗的领域。圣典上说，堕天使是撒旦的爪牙，他们执行他的意志、败坏秩序。他们是罪孽的缔造者、叛逆的策划者、永恒的诱惑者。他们就是阿尔萨蒙——毁灭之主，巴弗灭——疯狂的统治者，瑟尔迪——淫逸之母，以及阿兹瑞尔——堕落的大天使、撒旦的首位使者。他们四人连同撒旦一起，因对上帝犯下的罪行被逐出天堂。上帝的惩罚将他们束缚在地狱的牢狱之中。自此，地狱便是他们的新家与宫殿。他们从那里企图侵入我们的世界加以统治。但他们不会得逞，因为神的尘世王国受到真信仰的守护，那信仰犹如天使之盾。

changes.source: Certainly. As I've already said it was a cult of demoniacs, presumably established in the second half of the tenth century by a certain Lucius who declared himself to be a Dark Prophet. This Lucius reputedly foretold the end of the God's Earthly Kingdom and the freeing of Satan from his thousand years prison—as the Holy Scriptures tell us in the Apocalypse of the Saint Ezekiel. As you can see, it wasn't any breakthrough prophecy, because it stemmed from the notorious passage of the Holy Scriptures. Likewise the teachings of Lucius didn't differ much from the teachings of other heretical sects of that era—it ran upon the saying carpe diem. That means—do what you want, there's neither Heaven nor God, and even if it existed it wouldn't matter because in a couple of years the world would become a part of Hell. And who collaborates with hellspawns will rule over enslaved souls of the faithful. The Children of the New Order behaved roughly in that way and believed that when the end of the world comes and Satan sits on the throne of Heaven and Earth, they all would have a hell of a good time.
changes.before: 当然。正如我此前所说，这是一个恶魔崇拜的教团，大约由十世纪下半叶一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯所创立。据说这个卢修斯预言了神的尘世王国的终结，以及撒旦从千年囚禁中被释放——正如圣典在圣以西结的启示录中所告诉我们的。你看，这算不上什么惊世预言，因为它不过源自圣典中那段臭名昭著的经文。同样，卢修斯的教义与当时其他异端教派的教义也相差无几——其核心不过是那句格言"及时行乐"。也就是说——想做什么就做什么，既没有天堂也没有上帝；即便二者存在也无关紧要，因为再过几年世界就会成为地狱的一部分。而与地狱造物勾结之人，将统治信众被奴役的灵魂。新秩序之子的所作所为大致如此，他们相信当世界末日降临、撒旦登上天堂王座与大地王座之时，他们都能好好快活一场。

changes.source: You can run into many various monsters in Alvaron and around, Father. I've been a soldier for almost twenty years, but I'm still scared of the undead. You can kill a living opponent with a single well-directed blow, no matter what the opponent looks like. The undead are something completely different. You must hack the dead like a butcher to get them down, and even on the ground they wriggle and kick around themselves like a wild mare. Not talking about the damned souls, horrors and shadows, Father. There's nothing more terrible than an ethereal opponent...
changes.before: 在阿尔瓦伦及周边，你会遇上形形色色的怪物，神父。我从军近二十年，至今仍惧怕亡灵。对付活着的对手，只要一击命中要害便能了结，无论他看上去多么可怕。亡灵则完全是另一回事。你得像屠夫剁肉一样把它们劈倒，而即便倒地，它们仍会像烈马般扭踢不止。更别提那些该死的灵魂、恐怖之物与暗影了，神父。没有什么比无形的敌人更可怕……

changes.source: Unfortunately, the Baron didn't have a very good relationship with the rest of his family and because of that he decided to hide all his gold somewhere near Alvaron, not to let it get in the hands of his wicked relatives. And so he did—the Baron buried his treasure and died untroubled. I'm sure you can imagine, Father, that people are turning twice every stone in the neighborhood as they're trying to find that treasure...

changes.source: There are many legends told about Glatzburg, knight. It's an ancient city with roots stretched as far to the past as the year 223 when the nearby town of Galibornium was captured—it was the capital of the Erebornian province Filkland in those days. I'm sure you know about it. Well, many people use the legends and tales as a source of entertainment or thrill, but I'm always trying to find a grain of truth in every legacy of the past. To tell the truth, I've found many interesting facts or at least assumptions thanks to this approach. Look at the legend of St. Orthenius, for example. I'm sure you've heard it already, haven't you?
changes.before: 关于格拉茨堡的传说数不胜数，骑士。这是一座古老的城市，其历史可追溯至223年——那一年，附近的加利博尼姆镇被攻陷，当时它还是埃雷博恩人的菲尔克兰行省的首府。我相信你对此有所耳闻。许多人将这些传说和故事当作消遣或猎奇的谈资，但我始终试图在每一段历史遗存中寻得一丝真相。说实话，多亏了这种做法，我发现了不少有趣的事实，至少是合理的推断。就拿圣奥尔特尼乌斯的传说来说吧。我相信你已经听过了，不是吗？

changes.source: I didn't say that, knight. On the contrary, I think there's quite a lot of truth to that legend. However, the grains must be separated from the chaff at first. I spent quite a long time dealing with that legend and I studied its sources and other related links in the process. I concluded that the reference about the Inquisitor relic is true. Orthenius really had to have some very powerful weapon, otherwise nobody would mention it and the people would talk about superhuman power of his arms and so on. However, I don't believe the fate of our faith and of our Realm depends on the qualities of the weapon as such—no matter how excellent the qualities of the weapon were. That's nonsense, of course.
changes.before: 我可没这么说，骑士。恰恰相反，我认为那个传说中确实有不少真实的成分。不过，必须先去粗取精。我花了相当长的时间研究这个传说，期间查阅了它的来源以及其他相关线索。我得出的结论是，关于审判者圣物的记载是真实的。奥尔特尼乌斯手中一定握有一件极其强大的武器，否则不会有人提及它，人们只会谈论他双臂的超人力量之类的东西。然而，我不认为我们信仰与王国的命运取决于这件武器本身的特性——无论那特性多么卓越。那当然是无稽之谈。

changes.source: That's the question I tried to answer by the means of studying sources from that period, as well as tales of common people. Unfortunately I wasn't successful. There isn't a single reference where the relic could be and what happened to it after St. Orthenius died. However, I believe one source exists that contains this information—or at least a hint of it. It's the original text of the legend, written by Killian the chronicler in the 3rd century—that is immediately after Orthenius's death. I was looking for that source carefully in all the libraries and archives I could get into, but I didn't find it. I ran into some hints that the original handwritten work of Killian the chronicler could be deposited in the secret libraries of the Holy Mother Church somewhere in the Archbishop's Palace in Alvaron. That means it's absolutely inaccessible for me, so I've stopped my research regarding the matter.
changes.before: 这正是我试图通过研究那个时期的文献以及民间故事来回答的问题。遗憾的是，我并没有成功。没有任何一处记载提到圣物的下落，也没有记录圣奥尔特尼乌斯死后它遭遇了什么。不过，我相信存在一份包含这些信息——或者至少是相关线索的文献。那就是传说的原文，由编年史家基利安在三世纪写成——也就是奥尔特尼乌斯去世之后不久。我在所有能进入的图书馆和档案馆中仔细寻找过这份文献，但始终没有找到。我打探到一些线索，说基利安的手稿原本可能存放在圣母教会的秘密图书馆里，地点就在阿尔瓦隆的某座大主教宫中。这意味着我根本无法触及它，于是我便停止了对此事的研究。

changes.source: Of course, knight. Well, the legend about St. Orthenius tells how this great holy man, warlord and later also the patron of our Realm led the armies of all the faithful men to victory over the pagan realm of Ereborn here in the Filkland Peninsula in the year 223. He fought in the first line in most of the battles and he always was the one who caused the victory because he was able to get his fellow fighters into some kind of battle frenzy. However, he was a renowned fighter especially thanks to a powerful relic called The Inquisitor, reputedly blessed by the First Prophet himself.

changes.source: Nobody knows exactly what the weapon looked like, but legend says it was able to destroy dozens of pagans with each strike and it spread death wherever it was swayed. Soon the people started to believe that thanks to that relic Ereborn was defeated here in the Filkland Peninsula and that the relic was a gift from God given to St. Orthenius to ensure protection of the faith, church and of the Realm itself—as became obvious in the end. The legend further says that St. Orthenius foretold on his death bed that when the true faith would be threatened again, his follower would be found among the common people and he'd take over the relic to fight the enemies and to achieve another glorious victory.
changes.before: 没有人确切知道那件武器的模样，但传说它每次挥击都能击杀数十名异教徒，所过之处遍地死亡。很快，人们便开始相信，正是凭借这件圣物，埃雷博恩才在菲尔克兰半岛被击败；这件圣物是上帝赐予圣奥尔特尼乌斯的礼物，用以守护信仰、教会乃至王国本身——而最终的事实似乎也印证了这一点。传说还称，圣奥尔特尼乌斯在临终前预言：当真正的信仰再度面临威胁时，他的传人将从平民百姓中被找到，他会接过圣物，与敌人战斗，赢得又一次辉煌的胜利。

changes.source: I didn't say that, Father. On the contrary, I think there's quite a lot of truth in that legend. However, the grains must be separated from the chaff at first. I spent quite a long time dealing with that legend and I studied its sources and other related links in the process. I concluded that the reference about the Inquisitor relic is true. Orthenius really had to have some very powerful weapon, otherwise nobody would mention it and the people would talk about superhuman power of his arms and so on. However, I don't believe the fate of our faith and of our Realm depends on the qualities of the weapon as such—no matter how excellent the qualities of the weapon were. That's pure nonsense, of course.
changes.before: 我并没有那样说，神父。恰恰相反，我认为那则传说中确实包含不少真实的成分。不过，首先必须去粗取精。我花了相当长的时间研究那则传说，并在其过程中考察了它的来源与其他相关脉络。由此我得出结论：关于审判者圣物的记载是真实的。奥尔特尼乌斯确实曾拥有某种极为强大的武器，否则不会有人提及它，人们只会去谈论他双臂超人般的力量之类。然而，我并不认为我们信仰与王国的命运取决于武器本身的品质——无论那武器的品质何等卓越。那当然是纯粹的无稽之谈。

changes.source: Look at it in detail, Father. We have Arthamon here, the Lord of Destruction, Baphomet, the Ruler of Madness, Cerdie, the devilish Queen of Fornication, and the Fallen Archangel Azrael, the First Emissary of Satan's will. Arthamon embodies the element of ruination, of total doom, destruction, the manifestation of the anti-matter. What if I told you any of the Fallen Angel didn't exist—that he was just a personification of the powers that harmed and thwarted all what existed? It's the same for Baphomet—surely madness is an element of Chaos, thus it's condemnable and it was personified into Baphomet to let the faithful set their hate upon a specific creature. Even more easy it's for Cerdie—she's a courtesan of Hell who tempts both men and women to infidelity, destroys marriages and turns people to the Chaos. The Fallen Angel Azrael is the personification of all bad things Satan has on his conscience, that is all evil not being attributed to any of the other Chaos elements.
changes.before: 请仔细想想，神父。我们这里有阿尔萨蒙——毁灭之主，巴弗灭——疯狂的主宰，瑟尔迪——淫欲的邪魔女王，还有堕落大天使阿兹瑞尔——撒旦意志的首席使者。阿尔萨蒙体现的是毁灭的元素，是彻底的灾厄与崩毁，是反物质的显现。倘若我告诉您，某位堕落天使根本不存在——他不过是那些危害并阻碍一切存在之力量的人格化身呢？巴弗灭亦是同理——疯狂本就是混沌的元素，因而理当受谴，并被具象为巴弗灭，好让信众将仇恨倾注于一个具体的造物身上。瑟尔迪就更简单了——她是地狱的妓女，引诱男女背弃忠贞、摧毁婚姻，将人引入混沌。堕落大天使阿兹瑞尔，则是撒旦良知上一切罪恶的人格化身——也就是所有未归于其他混沌元素的恶行。

changes.source: Not at all, Father. I don't declare they don't exist—exactly to the contrary. We must fear them and we must face their plots. I only want to say I don't believe that these beings exist in the material conception. I don't believe there's a person named Arthamon or Baphomet in some infernal cavern. Look at the examples of the summoning of Hell forces—lower demons always take the appearance that their summoners imagined. So you can meet for example the demon Gaugliel described both as a horned multi-head beast and like a huge black snake singing with a velvet voice; and that's exactly what I think about the Fallen Angels.
changes.before: 绝非如此，神父。我并未宣称他们不存在——恰恰相反。我们必须恐惧他们，也必须直面他们的阴谋。我所要表达的只是：我不认为这些存在以物质形态现身。我不相信某个叫阿尔萨蒙或巴弗灭的家伙藏身于某座地狱洞穴中。看看召唤地狱力量的例子——低等恶魔总是呈现出召唤者所想象的形态。比如高格利尔这个恶魔，有人说它是长角的多头巨兽，也有人说它是以天鹅绒般嗓音歌唱的巨蟒——而我对堕落天使的看法正是如此。

changes.source: There are many legends told about Glatzburg, noble lord. It's an ancient city with roots stretched as far to the past as the year 223 when the nearby town of Galibornium was captured—it was the capital of the Erebornian province Filkland in those days. I'm sure you know about it. Well, many people use the legends and tales as a source of entertainment or thrill, but I'm always trying to find a grain of truth in every legacy of the past. To tell the truth, I've found many interesting facts or at least assumptions thanks to this approach. Look at the legend of St. Orthenius, for example. I'm sure you've heard it already, haven't you?
changes.before: 关于格拉茨堡流传着许多传说，贵族大人。这是一座古城，历史可追溯至公元223年——那一年，附近的加利博尼姆城陷落——当时它是埃雷博恩人的行省菲尔克兰的首府。我相信您一定听说过。嗯，许多人把传说和故事当作消遣或猎奇的来源，但我总试图在每一桩往昔遗存中寻出一丝真相。说实话，多亏了这种方法，我发现了不少有趣的事实，或者至少是假说。比如圣奥尔特尼乌斯的传说，我相信您已经听过了，对吧？

changes.source: Of course, noble lord. Well, the legend about St. Orthenius tells how this great holy man, warlord and later also the patron of our Realm led the armies of all the faithful men to victory over the pagan realm of Ereborn here in the Filkland Peninsula in the year 223. He fought in the first line in most of the battles and he always was the one who caused the victory because he was able to get his fellow fighters into some kind of battle frenzy. However, he was a renowned fighter especially thanks to a powerful relic called The Inquisitor, reputedly blessed by the First Prophet himself.

changes.source: Many tales are told about the manor of Baron Dawn von Blutenreich. Maybe you saw it yourself—it's such an awful ruin on the outskirts of Alvaron, a scar on the face of the city that used to be so beautiful. The people say that the Baron's impure ghost dwells in the manor, and it's true that terrible screams and crying is heard from there at nights, so the people got used to avoid the place...
changes.before: 关于唐·道恩·冯·布卢滕里希男爵的宅邸，流传着许多传说。也许你亲眼见过——那是阿尔瓦伦郊外的一片凄凉废墟，是这座曾经美丽之城脸庞上的一道伤疤。人们说，男爵不洁的鬼魂盘踞在宅邸之中，夜里确实能听见那里传来凄厉的尖叫与哭嚎，所以人们都习惯了避开那个地方……

changes.source: I owe a lot to my patron, Duke Abram of Longham. It was he who helped me out of the hole where I attended the scribing school as a boy and brought me here to Alvaron. He gave me the education and taught me all man needed to live in high society. Everything else I reached thanks to my diligence and intensive hard work. From a common royal scribe I became the royal counselor in the matters of law—as well as Domitius Ulpianus—and the King got to like me so much in the end that he made me his personal counselor.
changes.before: 我要大大感谢我的恩主——朗哈姆的阿布拉姆公爵。正是他将我从少年时就读的抄写学堂那个泥潭中拉了出来，带我来到这阿尔瓦伦。他为我提供了教育，教会我一个人立足于上流社会所需的一切。至于其余的一切，则全凭我的勤勉与不懈努力。我从一名普通的皇家抄写员，成长为掌管法律事务的御前顾问——与多米提乌斯·乌尔庇安如出一辙——而国王最终对我器重有加，任命我为他的私人顾问。

changes.source: Unbelievable! Are you telling me that Bishop Herbertius rose from his grave? That's infernal! And as if it was not enough, according to your words priest Romius was commanded by that spawn of darkness to steal the monstrance. A priest of the Holy Mother Church enthralled by infernal powers... I find it hard to believe, nevertheless I can't doubt your words, sir. It is obvious that heresy has rooted itself deep in this town—it has infected even the ranks of the Church. Nevertheless I am glad to say that you've completed your task with excellence! The monstrance is back and the perpetrator is revealed. That means I'm free to bestow the title of Baron of Asherbalt upon you. That is if you have 5,000 gp. to pay for the entry into the Gold Book of the Realm...
changes.before: 难以置信！你是说赫伯提乌斯主教从坟墓中复活了？这简直是地狱之灾！更糟的是，照你所言，牧师罗米乌斯竟是受那黑暗孽种的驱使才盗走了圣体光。一位圣母教会的牧师竟被地狱之力所蛊惑……我实在难以置信，然而阁下，我无法怀疑你的话。异端显然已在这座城镇深深扎根——甚至侵蚀了教会内部。不过我仍欣慰地说，你出色地完成了任务！圣体光已经归位，元凶也已查明。这意味着我得以将艾舍巴尔特男爵的头衔授予你——前提是你有五千金币支付载入王国金册的费用……

changes.source: My shop isn't enough for you, knight? I assure you all my wares are of the first-class quality and by far the best far and near. Nevertheless there are other shops around. Hans von Drichtmaul has a renowned armory in Glatzburg. The wise woman Enrie Jungwirdt and the alchemist Paolus Ventimus will sell you potions and various magic items. The innkeeper Wanda Gielwitch, and of course myself, sell all sorts of things. And if I may give you advice, avoid Alphonso DiCerbio. He sets up for a tradesman but in truth he's a mere thief and brazenly sells stolen goods.
changes.before: 我的店铺不合您意吗，骑士？我敢向您保证，我这儿的货物全是一流品质，远近首屈一指。不过城中也别有去处。汉斯·冯·德里希特毛尔在格拉茨堡经营着一家颇负盛名的军械铺。贤女恩丽·容维特和炼金术士保卢斯·文提穆斯会向您出售药水和各类魔法物品。旅店老板旺达·吉尔维奇，当然还有我本人，经营着各色商品。若容我提个忠告，离阿方索·迪切尔比奥远些。他以商人自居，实则不过是个盗贼，明目张胆地兜售赃物。

changes.source: There's much talking about a war, that's true. The whole royal regiment is on alert and no soldier may leave the city so they visit my inn more often than the drill-grounds. And they keep talking about various things—they say that the new commands from Alvaron have come to get ready and stay, so that new soldiers are being recruited and drilled to be ready for marching out and that horses and draft cattle are being requisitioned... I myself have lost two geldings and three oxen that way. But such it is these days, we can't do anything about it. People are quite terrified by all that silent humbug. It would be really bad if the war was to start. The strangest thing is that there's no enemy around to wage the war against. It's all quite weird.
changes.before: 关于战争确实众说纷纭，这话不假。整个王家军团已进入戒备，任何士兵都不得离城，于是他们来我旅店的次数比去操练场还多。他们总是谈论各种事情——据说阿尔瓦伦的新命令已经下来，要全军待命，新兵正在招募操练，随时准备开拔出征，马匹和役畜也在被征用……我自己就这样失去了两匹阉马和三头公牛。但如今就是这般光景，我们也无可奈何。百姓都被这股无声的骚动吓得不轻。真要是打起仗来可就糟了。最离奇的是，根本没有敌人可打。一切都透着古怪。

changes.source: I know about Father Frederick more than anyone else, son. Why, he was my longtime tutor and mentor! His name will stay engraved in my memory as long as I live. It was he who led me to the bosom of the Holy Mother Church and it was he who at the end of his life greatly encouraged me to become a member of the Holy Office. Father Frederick was a very wise man. He traveled a lot. He visited the Empire and dwelt at the Papal Court. He traveled through all the faithful realms of Kalmariland and talked with their highest church officials. According to his words—and I definitely don't doubt them—he visited even the Holy Grave of the First Prophet in Jevaran and bowed before his remains. He was the most educated and the most wise man I've ever met. And moreover he was as modest as every priest should be.
changes.before: 孩子，没有人比我更了解弗雷德里克神父。他可是我多年的导师与引路人！只要我一息尚存，他的名字便会镌刻在我的记忆之中。正是他引领我投入圣母教会的怀抱，也是他在生命尽头极力鼓励我加入圣务院。弗雷德里克神父是一位极具智慧的人。他游历甚广，曾到访帝国，并在教皇宫廷居住。他走遍了卡尔马里兰所有虔诚的国度，与各地最高的教会官员交谈。据他所说——我绝不会怀疑——他甚至亲赴杰瓦兰的先知圣墓，向第一先知的遗骸俯首致敬。他是我所见过学识最渊博、也最有智慧的人。而且，他如每一位牧师应有的那样谦逊。

changes.source: The Cult of the Children of the New Order? I've heard about it, of course. It's one of the historically important cases of the growth of a demonic sect and of the fight against it. It all happened in the second half of the 9th century of the Empire. It was at the end of the Hundred Years War, when the whole faithful world was burdened with bloody wars and despair was breaking human hearts like deadwood. At that time a certain Lucius, who deemed himself as a Dark Prophet, preached the end of the God's earthly kingdom and the freeing of Satan from his thousand years prison. With this teaching, that denied the Holy Mother Church, the Holy Scriptures and God himself, and urged the indecent and depraved life, he gathered around him a numerous group containing even the members of the imperial court. The Papal Holy Office was hard put to destroy the cult, but eventually it succeeded and during great proceedings it sentenced all the members of the cult—including Lucius himself—to be burned to death. As far as I know there have been no mention of the cult since then. Why are you asking?
changes.before: 新秩序之子教团？我当然听说过。这是邪教兴起及其被铲除这一历史上重要案例之一。事情发生在帝国九世纪下半叶。那正值百年战争末期，整个信仰世界被血腥战争重压，绝望如枯木般击碎人类的心灵。当时有一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯，宣扬神的尘世王国的终结，以及撒旦从千年囚禁中被释放。凭借这一否定圣母教会、圣典乃至上帝本人、并鼓吹淫乱堕落生活的教义，他聚拢了一大批追随者，其中甚至包括帝国宫廷的成员。教皇圣务院费尽周折才摧毁了这一教团，但最终成功了，在一场大审判中，教团全体成员——包括卢修斯本人——被判处火刑。据我所知，此后再未有关于该教团的记载。你为何问起这个？

changes.source: Then know it used to be the capital of this province at the time when the Filkland Peninsula belonged to the pagan realm of Ereborn. In the year of 223 the city was conquered by the faithful armies led by Saint Orthenius, and burned to the ground in order for it not to be inhabited ever again. Although there were attempts made to settle it again, there hanged the shadow of the pagan curse above the ruins. Instead of the city becoming a beautiful new faithful town, as it happened in the case of Alvaron people had to abandon it and lay the foundations of Glatzburg several miles away, in a place that was much less favorable.
