changes.source: I know about Father Frederick more than anyone else, brother. Why, he was my longtime tutor and mentor! His name will stay engraved in my memory as long as I live. It was he who led me to the bosom of the Holy Mother Church and it was he who at the end of his life greatly encouraged me to become a member of the Holy Office. Father Frederick was a very wise man. He traveled a lot. He visited the Empire and dwelt at the Papal Court. He traveled through all the faithful realms of Kalmariland and talked with their highest church officials. According to his words—and I definitely don't doubt them—he visited even the Holy Grave of the First Prophet in Jevaran and bowed before his remains. He was the most educated and the most wise man I've ever met. And moreover he was as modest as every priest should be.
changes.before: 我比任何人都了解弗雷德里克神父，兄弟。他可是我多年的导师与引路人！他的名字将铭刻在我的记忆中，直至我生命的尽头。正是他引领我走进圣母教会的怀抱，也正是他在生命的最后岁月里，极力鼓励我成为圣务院的一员。弗雷德里克神父是一位极具智慧的人。他游历甚广。他曾到访帝国，并在教皇宫廷居住。他走遍了卡尔马里兰所有虔诚的领地，与各地最高教会官员交谈。据他所说——我绝不会怀疑他的话——他甚至曾前往杰瓦兰的先知圣墓，向第一先知的遗骸躬身致敬。他是我所见过最有学识、最有智慧的人。而且，他如每一位牧师应有的那般谦逊。

changes.source: This is Edmond d'Arvias's letter to Bishop Trevorius in Glatzburg. It reads:\\n\\nDear friend,\\nI sincerely hope you receive this letter in kind health and fair circumstance, despite the evils plaguing us all. I would trouble you, Trevorius, to aid the bearer of this letter with an investigation of the utmost importance. Though I tremble to write the words which follow, I fear even more your disbelieving them, old friend. There has been a conspiracy in Hillbrandt to invoke the fallen angel, Arthamon—a conspiracy, I fear, which has likely succeeded. What makes the case all the more troubling is that Bishop Vallarian, who you know well from the Inquisitorial Curia of Glatzburg, has been convicted of the crime.\\nAs you can see, this is no petty case of hearsay heresy. Though the betrayal of an inquisitorial judge frightens me to no end, Trevorius, certain truths which have come to light bring a chill to my very soul. Though it may only be the rambling of a doomed man, Judge Vallarian left a warning for the bearer of this letter; the Children of the New Order, of which you certainly know more than I, walk the Earth again.\\nI would ask you to afford the bearer of this letter all possible assistance with his investigation, and to help him discover the truth behind Judge Vallarian’s betrayal. I fear more than my peace of mind hangs in the balance, old friend.\\nEver Yours, Edmond

这是埃德蒙·达尔维亚斯在格拉茨堡写下的致特雷维里乌斯主教的信。信上写道：

亲爱的朋友，
尽管邪恶正困扰着我们所有人，我仍由衷希望你收到此信时身心康健、境遇顺遂。我要劳烦你，特雷维里乌斯，协助持信人进行一项至关重要的调查。写下接下来这些字句时我双手颤抖，老朋友，但我更害怕的是你不肯相信。希尔布兰特发生了一起召唤堕落天使阿尔萨蒙的阴谋——我担心，这阴谋恐怕已经得逞。更令此案棘手的是，你在格拉茨堡宗教裁判庭便熟知的瓦拉里安主教，已被判定犯下此罪。
如你所见，这绝非一桩道听途说的异端小事。尽管一名宗教裁判法官的背叛已让我恐惧万分，特雷维里乌斯，某些浮出水面的真相更令我的灵魂发寒。纵然这可能只是一个将死之人的胡言乱语，瓦拉里安法官还是给持信人留下了一句警告：新秩序之子——关于他们你自然比我更清楚——已重临世间。
我恳请你给予持信人一切可能的协助，帮助他查明瓦拉里安法官背叛背后的真相。老朋友，悬于一线的，远不止我一人的安宁。
永远属于你的，埃德蒙

changes.source: This is the testament of Father Bartholomeus, first Superior of the Order of Saint Orthenius. By all rights, the man should have been considered a saint himself. The order was established to preserve the heritage of the Great Liberator, and legends say Father Bartholomeus was among the most dedicated to protecting Orthenius’s legacy. However, according to this text, the order may have had another purpose — one I’ve certainly never heard of. It reads:\\n\\nNightmares haunt my rest, chilling visions of the death awaiting all who share the Order’s secret. The secret of the keys! Oh, cruel fate; why must you destroy those who throw themselves willingly at your mercy? No matter. We must never risk disclosing the secret of the keys to our enemies — even in death. I shall pen it here, in my Final Testament of Faith, to be buried alongside me in the impenetrable tomb which awaits my aging flesh. If you lay eyes upon this holy document, I charge you – if you be a God-fearing servant – to avenge our murder and to take up the mantle we have relinquished. If you be foe, I pray that the Lord God strips the flesh from your worthless bones and burns your peeled rind in Hell for all eternity for seeking our death.Steady yourself, traitor hand – death is but God’s path to immortality.\\n\\nForgive me my mortal weakness.\\n\\nThe first thing you must know, brother-champion, is this: the three keys are actually jade statuettes fashioned in the image of the three emissaries of God – Michael, Gabriel, and Raphael. Each statuette lies in a different corner of the Realm, hidden away and guarded by contraptions guaranteed to kill any intruder weak of mind or conviction. Their locations are as follows:\\n\\nThe Statuette of Raphael was buried beneath the Sacred Tree near the village of Hillbrandt, nestled in the foothills of the Moonshine Mountains. In the shade of that very tree, St. Orthenius converted hundreds of pagan warriors to the True Faith after besieging their fortress stronghold.\\n\\nThe Statuette of Michael rests in Galibornium, in the former Temple of All Gods, which St. Orthenius cleansed and consecrated personally in the name of the Holy Mother.\\n\\nFinally, the Statuette of Gabriel was hidden in the first Episcopal temple built upon the shores of Filkland Peninsula, in the city now known as Alvaron, where the Orthodox Patriarch Basilian erected his residence as the new Rex.\\n\\nIf these keys you seek, brother champion, be wary – that which lies in wait cares none for the purity in your heart. To claim the statuettes, you will need to treat-lightly and with the grace of God. Go now, with my blessing if you be a friend of the Faith, or my blackest curses otherwise.
changes.before: 这是圣奥塞尼乌斯教团首任会长巴托罗缪神父的遗嘱。按理说，此人本应被尊为圣人。该教团的创立是为了守护伟大解放者的遗产，传说巴托罗缪神父是守护奥塞尼乌斯遗志最为虔诚的人之一。然而，据这份文本所述，教团或许另有目的——一个我从未听闻过的目的。文中写道：\\n\\n噩梦纠缠着我的安眠，令人胆寒的幻象预示着所有分享教团秘密之人的死期。钥匙的秘密！哦，残酷的命运；你为何非要毁灭那些甘愿向你俯首乞怜之人？不过这不重要。我们绝不能冒着向敌人泄露钥匙秘密的风险——即便死后亦然。我将把这一切写在此处，在我的最终信仰遗嘱中，让它与我一同葬入那座等待我这副衰老皮囊的坚不可摧的坟墓。若你目睹了这份神圣文书，我在此责令你——倘若你是敬畏主上帝的仆从——为我们复仇，并接下我们已卸下的重担。若你是敌人，我祈求主上帝剥去你那贱骨上的血肉，将你剥下的皮囊在地狱中永世焚烧，为你觊觎我们的性命付出代价。稳住，叛逆的手——死亡不过是上帝通往不朽的道路。\\n\\n宽恕我这凡人的软弱。\\n\\n你必须知道的第一件事，战士兄弟，便是：三把钥匙实为翡翠雕像，依照上帝三位使者——米迦勒、加百列与拉斐尔的形象雕琢而成。每座雕像都藏在王国的不同角落，隐匿于暗处，并由一旦触发便足以杀死任何意志薄弱或信念不坚的入侵者的机关守护。它们的下落如下：\\n\\n拉斐尔雕像被埋葬在希尔布兰特村附近的圣树之下，该村坐落于月光山脉的山麓之中。正是在那棵树的荫蔽之下，圣奥塞尼乌斯围攻了异教战士的堡垒要塞之后，将数百名异教战士引归正统信仰。\\n\\n米迦勒雕像安放在加利博尼姆的古万神殿中，圣奥塞尼乌斯曾亲自以圣母之名将其净化并祝圣。\\n\\n最后，加百列雕像被藏在建于菲尔克兰半岛海岸的第一座主教圣殿之中，该城如今名为阿尔瓦伦，正统的巴西利安宗主教在此建起了他作为新任Rex的居所。\\n\\n若你正在寻找这些钥匙，战士兄弟，务必小心——潜伏之物对你心中的纯洁毫无兴趣。要夺取这些雕像，你须轻手轻脚，并蒙上帝的恩典。去吧，若你是信仰的朋友，便带着我的祝福；否则，便带着我最恶毒的诅咒。

changes.source: What a treasure! This volume is immensely valuable, not only to me but the Faith as a whole. This is the Chronicle of Father Killian, a master historian who lived centuries ago. It details the period between the Rise of the True Faith and the Fall of the Erebornian Empire. Of particular importance are the years 180-236 of the New Era, when Saint Orthenius, Patron and Protector of the Realm, walked the earth spreading the True Faith with blade and tongue. Were it not for the wiles of Orthenius, Ultherst may never have risen from the ashes of Ereborn.\\n\\nBut Killian was not simply one of Orthenius’s contemporaries; he was also one of the saint’s followers. As such, the tales found in his Chronicle are the source of many of the more recognizable stories involving the Great Saint’s travels.\\n\\nPerhaps the most popular tale taken from Killian’s Chronicle is the legend of the Successor, the one who was destined rise in St. Orthenius’s absence as Patron and Protector of the Realm. According to the legend, the Successor would some day come to possess a powerful relic known as “the Inquisitor” – an artifact of immense power which would allow him to destroy any evil as St. Orthenius destroyed the ancient Erebornians. Killian’s telling of the tale, however, dispels much of the superstition that age and countless re-tellings have attached to the legend:\\n\\nOn the day of his death, the Saint Orthenius climbed a small hill near Alvaron and lay down at a the base of a massive pine tree.\\n-'Today I will leave this world,' he told his companions. 'But shed not a tear for me, for it is the Will of the Lord which compels me to rest. It is He who measures our time and rations it to us, each the length he or she requires to do what is necessary.\\n-'But what will we do without your guidance,' asked the one they called Despairer. 'The pagans will rally at your death! They will return and slaughter us as lambs; the Faith will surely perish!\\n-If you heed these words, never shall the Faith fall,' replied Orthenius. 'First, you must construct me a tomb from the stone of the Earth and bless it three times in the name of God Almighty. Bury me within and bless the tomb thrice more. Once my body is at rest, set about carving three statuettes from the purest jade under the stars, one for each of God’s mighty archangels,’ Orthenius said, staring into the bark of the great pine. ‘Bless them and bind them to my tomb so that it may never be opened without them. If ever an enemy should rise to challenge the Faith, break the seal on my tomb and retrieve from my grave a weapon, the very manifestation of God’s wrath. You will know it when first you lay eyes upon it, and it will likewise know You. It will answer to “Inquisitor.” Do not hesitate to use it! In idle hands, the Inquisitor will prove as deadly to the innocent as the guilty, for so is God’s Word mighty in calloused hands and dangerous in those which are soft.'\\n\\nAnd the companions did what he said. At the site of his death they constructed a majestic tomb and laid the body of their master within. They then sealed the tomb using the three statuettes – one carved in the image of Raphael, Gabriel, and Michael each. Afterward, they hid the three statuettes and vowed never to relinquish the secret of their whereabouts so long as they all should live. Their final act was to form a pact, the Order of Saint Orthenius, and swear an oath to defend their master’s secret for all eternity. I, Killian, bear sacred witness to these deeds, and so these deeds took place. Amen.
changes.before: 何等珍宝！此卷价值连城，于我、于整个信仰皆是如此。这便是基利安神父的《编年史》，他是一位数百年前生活的大史家。书中详述了自真信仰崛起至埃雷博恩帝国覆灭之间的那段岁月。其中尤以新纪元180至236年为重——那段岁月里，圣奥塞尼乌斯，王国的守护者，行走于大地之上，以刀剑与言语传扬真信仰。若非奥塞尼乌斯的谋略，乌尔瑟斯特或许永无从埃雷博恩的灰烬中崛起。\\n\\n但基利安并非只是与奥塞尼乌斯同时代之人；他亦是这位圣者的追随者之一。因此，他编年史中的故事，正是有关大圣者漫游事迹中许多广为人知之说的源头。\\n\\n或许取自《基利安编年史》流传最广的故事，便是"继承者"的传说——那命中注定要在圣奥塞尼乌斯缺席之时崛起、成为王国守护者之人。传说中，继承者有朝一日将拥有一件名为"审判官"的强大圣物——一件蕴含无穷威力的造物，能让他如圣奥塞尼乌斯荡灭古代埃雷博恩人那般，摧毁一切邪恶。然而基利安对这故事的讲述，驱散了岁月与无数复述附着于其上的诸多迷信：\\n\\n在他离世之日，圣奥塞尼乌斯攀上阿尔瓦伦附近的一座小丘，在一棵巨大松树的根旁躺下。\\n"今日我将离开这个世界，"他对同伴们说，"但莫为我落泪，因为正是主的旨意催我安息。量度我们的光阴、按份分给我们的，正是祂——各人所得的长短，恰够完成各自当行之事。\\n"可若没有您的指引，我们该怎么办？"那被唤作绝望者的人问道，"异教徒会在您死时集结！他们会卷土重来，把我们如羔羊般屠杀；信仰必将覆灭！\\n"若你们听从这些话，信仰便永不至倾覆，"奥塞尼乌斯答道。"首先，你们须以大地之石为我筑一座陵墓，并奉全能的上帝之名祝圣三次。将我葬于其中，再为陵墓祝圣三次。待我肉身安息，便趁星空之下，以最纯净的玉石雕成三尊小像，各献给上帝一位大能的总天使，"奥塞尼乌斯说着，目光凝在那棵巨松的树皮上。"为它们祝圣，并将它们系于我的陵墓之上，使它们不齐，墓门永不可开。若果真有仇敌兴起挑战信仰，便打破我墓上的封印，从我坟中取出一件兵器——那正是上帝震怒的化身。你初见它时便能认出它，而它也同样认得你。它听命于'审判官'之名。切莫迟疑，尽管使用！落在懒散之手，审判官对无辜者与有罪者一般致命；因为上帝之言，在布满老茧的手中威能万钧，在柔嫩的手中却危险万分。'"\\n\\n同伴们照他所言而行。在他离世之处，他们筑起一座宏伟陵墓，将主人的遗体安放其中。随后他们用那三尊小像封住了陵墓——分别依拉斐尔、加百列与米迦勒的形象雕成。此后，他们藏起那三尊小像，发誓只要众人尚有一日存活，便绝不泄露其下落之秘。他们最后的举动，是立下誓约，结成圣奥塞尼乌斯教团，并发誓永恒守护主人的秘密。我，基利安，为此等事迹作神圣见证，故这些事迹确曾发生。阿门。

changes.source: A single glance at this abominable volume would likely drive a normal man insane. The book itself is bound in human flesh, and painted with scenes of the most unimaginable depravity. The scenes, painted in blood which never dries, swirl and slither across the book’s ghastly, writhing cover. If what I know of the book is true, it was written in the year 850 by the Dark Prophet, Lucius, founder of the Children of New Order. Judging from the living script, it seems to detail the rise of the fallen angels, Arthamon, Baphomet and Cerdie.\\n\\nLucius describes the rites for summoning the fallen angels in the most thorough... and sickening terms. His descriptions and instructions as to how the Children should go about committing the atrocities needed to bring Hell to Earth are terrifying, in a word. This Dark Prophet, this Lucius, could never have been a man of flesh and blood like me. The implications of that possibility are... are too frightening to even consider.\\n\\nLord protect me, there’s more. Apparently, one of the Children will be “Marked by the Beast,” and it will be his or her duty to perform the ritual necessary to bring Hell to our world:\\n\\n”Blessed are the chosen, the vessels of corruption! Carry on your person, marked champion, this tome, for through it are channeled the powers which will open the way. To open the gates of Hell, you must be willing to sacrifice. First, you must make an offering of the blood of your brow, breast, and loins. When the unclean blood has mixed at your feet, use it as ink to inscribe the drawn mark upon the gateway. Your mortal form will be consumed, for great and powerful are the fires of Hell, but your spirit will live forever among the princes of the damned, and your sacrifice will bring about the end of God’s feeble, flawed creation.”\\n\\nMay the angels forgive me for what I have read, and may God shed his mercy over me. I must end this, once and for all.
changes.before:
仅凭一瞥，这本可憎之书便足以令常人发疯。书本身以人类的皮肤装订，封面绘满了难以想象的堕落场景。那些场景用永不干涸的鲜血绘成，在书封可怖而蠕动的表面上盘旋滑行。若我所知属实，此书成于850年，作者是暗黑先知卢修斯——新秩序之子的创立者。从那些活生生的文字来看，书中详述了堕落天使阿尔萨蒙、巴弗灭与塞尔迪的崛起。

卢修斯以最详尽……也最令人作呕的笔触，描述了召唤堕落天使的仪式。他关于新秩序之子应如何犯下那些罪行、以将地狱带入人间的描述与指示，简而言之，令人胆寒。这位暗黑先知，这个卢修斯，绝不可能是像我这样的血肉之躯。那种可能性所隐含的意味……实在太可怕，甚至不敢去想。

主啊，护佑我，后面还有。据记载，新秩序之子中有一人将"被兽标记"，由他或她来履行仪式，将地狱带入我们的世界：

"蒙福的是被拣选者，腐化的器皿！背负这卷圣典吧，被标记的勇士，因为正是通过它，通往彼方的力量得以传导。欲开启地狱之门，你必须甘愿献祭。首先，你须以额间、胸前与腰腹之血作为祭品。当污秽之血在你脚下交融，便以它为墨，将画好的印记刻于门扉之上。你的肉身将被吞噬，因地狱之火强大而炽烈；但你的灵魂将与被诅咒的诸王永存，而你的牺牲将终结上帝那脆弱而残缺的造物。"

愿天使宽恕我所读到的一切，愿上帝将怜悯倾注于我。我必须终结这一切，一劳永逸。
changes.after: 仅凭一瞥，这本可憎之书便足以令常人发疯。书本身以人类的皮肤装订，封面绘满了难以想象的堕落场景。那些场景用永不干涸的鲜血绘成，在书封可怖而蠕动的表面上盘旋滑行。若我所知属实，此书成于850年，作者是黑暗先知卢修斯——新秩序之子的创立者。从那些活生生的文字来看，书中详述了堕落天使阿尔萨蒙、巴风特与塞尔迪的崛起。\\n\\n卢修斯以最详尽……也最令人作呕的笔触，描述了召唤堕落天使的仪式。他关于新秩序之子应如何犯下那些罪行、以将地狱带入人间的描述与指示，简而言之，令人胆寒。这位黑暗先知，这个卢修斯，绝不可能是像我这样的血肉之躯。那种可能性所隐含的意味……实在太可怕，甚至不敢去想。\\n\\n主啊，护佑我，后面还有。据记载，新秩序之子中有一人将"被兽标记"，由他或她来履行仪式，将地狱带入我们的世界：\\n\\n"蒙福的是被拣选者，腐化的器皿！背负这卷圣典吧，被标记的勇士，因为正是通过它，通往彼方的力量得以传导。欲开启地狱之门，你必须甘愿献祭。首先，你须以额间、胸前与腰腹之血作为祭品。当污秽之血在你脚下交融，便以它为墨，将画好的印记刻于门扉之上。你的肉身将被吞噬，因地狱之火强大而炽烈；但你的灵魂将与被诅咒的诸王永存，而你的牺牲将终结上帝那脆弱而残缺的造物。"\\n\\n愿天使宽恕我所读到的一切，愿上帝将怜悯倾注于我。我必须终结这一切，一劳永逸。

changes.source: The Theologia Arcanea was penned by the greatest mind to ever grace the faithful world, SaintEfarius. It deals heavily with the relationship between the blessing we know as the “Divine Presence” and the whole of God’s creation. Several logical arguments for the existence of God precede a detailed theoretical explanation as to why the Divine Presence, believed by many to the Holy Ghost itself, manifests in mortals as a form of expendable energy.\\n\\nThe Theologia Arcanea is the cornerstone for the understanding of the mystical powers contained within the rites and symbols of the Holy Mother Church. The text is considered to be almost as important as the Scriptures themselves. A comprehensive understanding of the principles described in the book would be nearly impossible for the common man to come by, yet, anyone who can fully grasp the concepts could master them.\\n\\nThough an invaluable asset to the defense of the Faith, there are many who worry that uncontrolled exposure to the book could lead to the manipulation of its incantations by heretics and traitors who would use the secrets therein to bring the Church to its knees.

《神学秘典》由曾惠泽信仰世界的最伟大头脑——圣埃法里乌斯——所著。书中大量探讨了我们所知的"神圣临在"之恩典与上帝全部造物之间的关系。开篇先提出数条关于上帝存在的逻辑论证，随后详细阐述了神圣临在为何会在凡人身上以一种可消耗能量的形式显现——许多人相信那就是圣灵本身。

《神学秘典》是理解圣母教会仪式与符号中所蕴含之神秘力量的基石。该书被认为几乎与圣典同等重要。常人几乎不可能全面理解书中所述的原理，然而，任何能够完全领悟其概念之人，皆可将其掌握。

尽管此书是捍卫信仰的无价之宝，仍有诸多人士忧心：若任由其不受约束地流传，可能导致异端与叛徒篡改其中的咒文，利用其中的秘密将教会推向深渊。

changes.source: Episkopos Invociren wrote Adversum Maleficarum as a guide for those who devote their lives to battling the forces of evil, particularly those who become conduits for unholy magic. Many of the chapters detail the performing of rites and prayers needed by warriors of God to protect and deliver themselves from evil, but a few of the later chapters also deal with the performance of certain rites of exorcism. Such rites are said to be able to cleanse entire villages, driving legions of demons out of unwilling or unknowing hosts with relative ease.\\n\\nThe book became an indispensable tool of the True Faith’s defense soon after its publication. The Holy Council declared that the work had been written under the influence of Divine Inspiration, and vowed that the volume would stand beside the Scriptures and the Theologia Arcanea as one of the cornerstones of the Church’s defense.\\n\\nPope Urbianus II ordered that copies of the Adversum Maleficarum be sent to every holding from Empire of Lochland to the most remote villages on the fringes of the Orthodox world with the express intention of spreading the Faith and its protection as far as humanly possible.

主教英沃西伦撰写《反巫术论》，作为献给那些毕生致力于对抗邪恶势力之人的指南，尤其是那些成为不洁魔法通道之人。书中多章详述了上帝的战士为保护自身、免受邪恶侵袭而需进行的仪式与祈祷，但后几章亦涉及某些驱魔仪式。据说此类仪式能够净化整个村庄，将成群的恶魔从不情愿或不知情的宿主体内驱逐出去，且相对轻松。

此书出版后不久，便成为捍卫真信仰不可或缺的利器。神圣议会宣称该作是在神圣启示的感召下写成，并发誓此书将与圣典和《神学秘典》并列，成为教会防御体系的基石之一。

教皇乌尔比亚努斯二世下令，将《反巫术论》的抄本分发至从洛奇兰帝国到正统世界最偏远村落的每一处领地，意在尽可能将信仰及其庇护传遍人间。

changes.source: This strange parchment was among Judge Vallarian’s possessions. Made from human skin and etched in an ancient language, the secrets it holds could be crucial to understanding what the fallen judge’s sinister intentions were.\\n\\nThe translation, provided by Wisewoman Enrie Jungwirdt, reads:\\n\\nOn the Eve of Damned Balduin\\nNine years after the Night without Wood\\nThe Four Messages intact with Seals\\nFor the men in Red Robes\\nFor the traitors of Umbria\\nTo the land of No Man where no stakes burned\\n\\nEach Twenty and One years after the Damned Balduin\\nNine successive followers\\nThis is the Plan\\n\\nIn the crypt of pagans who saw the Light\\n\\nThe Last will meet and then go in Three Directions\\n\\nInto the Shadow of a Dragon the First will step\\n\\nThe Second shall go where the Denhelitians once danced\\n\\nAnd the Third must find Satan’s Maw\\n\\nThe prison shall be opened, and vengeance will come.

草药师恩丽·容维特的译文如下：

于受诅者鲍德温前夜
无木之夜后第九年
四道讯息，封印完好
致红袍之人
致翁布里亚的叛徒
至无人之境，那里未曾燃起火刑桩

自受诅者鲍德温起每二十一年
九位相继的追随者
此即计划

在曾见圣光之异教徒的地穴中

末者将聚，而后分赴三个方向

第一步者踏入龙之阴影

第二者前往登赫利蒂人曾起舞之地

changes.source: When the Erstwick Crusade began, King Luther quickly realized his lightly armored militias would do little but die gracelessly in a akirmishwith the heavy cavalry of his enemies. According to legend, in one of Luther’s many fear-induced fever dreams, he met the angel Raphael, who advised him to journey to a forlorn fishing village on the shores of the Northern Sea. There, the angel claimed, Luther would find his people’s salvation.\n\\n When Luther arrived, he found little of use. The town was little more than a gathering of shanties, fallen into disrepair. As he prepared to leave, hopeless and broken, he saw fishermen spearing fish off the coast with long, wicked spears. The realization struck immediately. Luther ordered thousands of the specially-crafted spears for his armies—weapons that would soon be known as “pikes” for the town in which he’d found them, “Pike’s Landing.\\n\\nAt first, there were doubts about the efficiency of the new weapons among his men, and after a time, Luther feared they would refuse them in favor of more traditional swords and axes. Understanding that his men would never trust a spear in the command of a sword-wielding king, Luther had his own pike made. Beautiful and deadly, he had the weapon blessed by John Herman II, the Patriarch of the reformed Church of the True Word. At the behest of his men, Luther named the weapon the “Spike of Erstwick.”\\n\\n When the sun rose on the dawn of the first battle of the Erstwick Crusades, Luther hefted his pike and led his men with a cry and prayer into a veritable horde of marauding crusaders. Faced with the enemy’s heavy cavalry, Luther conquered unquestionably, dominating the field inboth Sadron and Meinheim. Horsemen the world over soon learned to fear the warrior king with the ten-foot reach. Luther’s name, and the name of his weapon, spread like wildfire across the civilized orld.\\n\\nThe Spike of Erstwick remained in the possession of Erstwick’s Kings until 1210, when it was stripped from the fallen king Darmont I. Though Erstwick won the war, the Ultherstians claimed the Spike of Erstwick as a spoil of war. It has remained in Ultherst ever since, longing to feel again Luther’s touch and the succulent warmth of horseflesh.

changes.source: Few angels hold the same level of esteem as Gabriel, the emissary. According to legend, it was he who saved the life of Friedrich the Brave, King of Lochland, at the Battle of Kunth in the year 411.//n//n The Battle of Kunth was the culmination of treason by Lochland’s Northern nobles against the Imperial Crown. Unsatisfied with Friedrich’s rule, the Northern lords vowed to take Lochland by force, threatening to break the nation into several small holdings if necessary. The royalists and separatists clashed near a small village named Kunth, where Friedrich soon found himself surrounded by the vastly superior numbers of unionist armies.\\n\\nWith a will of stone and the heart of a conqueror, Friedrich led a counterattack againstGrand Duke Vittorio the Hollander, the leader of the Northern Separation Union. In the end the savage duel ended with the Friedrich's victory—according to legends he owed that to the Archangel Gabriel who used a blessed, angelic shield to block several fatal blows from Vittorio. The rumor is that after the battle, Friedrich fell to his knees and prayed to Gabriel for delivering the battle to the righteous. Never far from the field, the Archangel heard his plea and appeared to bestow upon him a shield which would serve the leaders of Lochland for centuries. The Empire of Lochland, which has always been a firm bastion of the True Faith, has since made the shield a part of their very culture.\\n\\n The shield remained in the Imperial Armory until 1145 when it was given to King Joachym XII of Ultherst for his lending his aid in the Second Crusade. The shield has belonged to Ultherst ever since.
changes.before:
很少有天使能获得与使者加百列同等的敬重。据传，正是他在411年的昆斯战役中拯救了洛奇兰国王勇敢的弗里德里希的性命。//n//n 昆斯战役是洛奇兰北方贵族对帝国王冠叛逆的顶点。北方领主们对弗里德里希的统治不满，发誓以武力夺取洛奇兰，威胁必要时将国家分裂为数个小小领地。保皇派与分离派在名为昆斯的小村庄附近交战，弗里德里希很快发现自己被联盟军压倒性的人数所包围。

凭借着磐石般的意志和征服者的心脏，弗里德里希对北方分离联盟的领袖——大公爵"荷兰人"维托里奥发起了反击。最终，这场凶猛的决斗以弗里德里希的胜利告终——据传，这要归功于大天使加百列，他用一面受祝福的天使之盾挡下了维托里奥的数次致命攻击。传闻战后，弗里德里希跪倒在地，向加百列祈祷，感谢他将胜利赐予正义的一方。大天使始终未曾远离战场，他听到了弗里德里希的祈求，显现出并赐予他一面盾牌，此盾在数百年间守护着洛奇兰的统治者。洛奇兰帝国始终是真信仰的坚固堡垒，自此将这面盾牌融入了他们的文化之中。

 这面盾牌一直保存在皇家军械库中，直到1145年，为嘉奖乌尔瑟斯特的约阿希姆十二世国王在第二次十字军东征中提供的援助，将其赐予了他。自那时起，这面盾牌便归乌尔瑟斯特所有。

changes.source: Few men have and ever will live up to the legend of Pontheus, wielder of Gladius Maximus, the blade which tamed the Galibornium Coliseum. Even though he was just a slave, Pontheus the slayer became would go on ot become more famous than any of his contemporaries, perhaps with the exception of Emperor Constantine, the Erebornian ruler who was overthrown by the armies of the faithful.\\n\\nPontheus's sword was most likely created by the priests and theurgists of the Cult of the Creators,who made their residences in the dungeons beneath the Coliseum. There, they worked ceaselessly turning hapless creatures and slaves into fearsome monsters fit for Pontheus’ blade. Audiences thousands strong packed the Coliseum day after day to watch the slayer fight, and day after day they were amazed by his cunning and brutality.\\n\\n After Galibornium was conquered by the army of Saint Orthenius, the Coliseum’s entrance was sealed and all of its inhabitants were left there to meet a gruesome end. It should be noted that, years later, when the gates were reopened, the body of Pontheus was not among the dead.
changes.before:
过去很少有人、将来也不会有人能够匹敌庞修斯的传奇——至大之刃的持有者，那柄驯服了加利博尼姆斗兽场的利刃。尽管他只是个奴隶，屠戮者庞修斯后来的名声超越了所有同时代的人，也许只有被信众军队推翻的埃雷博恩人统治者君士坦丁皇帝除外。

庞修斯的剑很可能出自造物主教团的牧师与术法师之手，他们居住在斗兽场下方的地牢中。在那里，他们不停地将不幸的生物和奴隶变成足以匹敌庞修斯之刃的可怕怪物。成千上万的观众日复一日地挤满斗兽场，观看屠戮者的战斗，日复一日地为他的狡诈与残暴所折服。

 在加利博尼姆被圣奥塞尼乌斯的军队征服后，斗兽场的入口被封死，其中所有的居民都被留在那里等待凄惨的结局。值得注意的是，多年后当大门重新开启时，死者中并没有庞修斯的遗体。

changes.source: According to scripture, the man who would eventually become Saint George belonged to a rich family living in Cappadocia, the easternmost province of the Erebornian Empire. He served in the army of Emperor Diocletianus as an officer, accompanying the Emperor on his journey through the province. It seemed at one point that a promising future lay before the young officer. At a young age, his name was already known to perhaps the most powerful man in the world. All that changed, however in 118, when George accepted the True Faith and was mercilessly tortured to death for his beliefs.\\n\\n According to another legend, Saint George embraced the True Faith after he met a vicious dragon on some far flung battlefield. The ultimate incarnation of the beast, George fought for hours before the beast was slain, and only then because Gabriel himself had blessed the tip of his lance.\\n\\nRegardless of when George turned to the faith, the blessed lance was a thing of truth. It was lost after the Saint's death, but was found again during the First Crusade. Bearing the might of The Emissary himself, the lance became a symbol for the liberators of the Holy Grave. After the battle of Nashamir Fields, where the Crusaders suffered a terrible defeat at the hands of Omar II, the lance came into the possession of Aerin de Gublaire, a commander of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. When the crusaders returned from the Holy Lands, Gublaire brought the precious relic with him. It has remained in the Realm ever since.
changes.before:
据经文记载，日后成为圣乔治之人的男子出身于卡帕多西亚一个富裕家庭，该省是埃雷博恩人的帝国最东端的行省。他在戴克里先皇帝军中担任军官，随皇帝巡视该省。一度看来，这位年轻军官的前途无可限量。年纪轻轻，他的名字便已为世上最有权势之人所知。然而在118年，一切都因乔治皈依真信仰而改变——他因信仰被无情折磨致死。

 另一则传说称，圣乔治是在一片遥远战场上遭遇恶龙之后，才皈依真信仰的。那恶龙乃巨兽的终极化身，乔治与其鏖战数小时方将其斩杀——而能成此事，只因加百列亲自祝福了他的枪尖。

无论乔治何时转向信仰，那柄受祝福的长枪确有其事。圣人死后它便遗失，却在第一次十字军东征中重见天日。承载着使者本人的威能，这柄长枪成为解放圣地墓穴者的象征。在纳沙米尔原野战役中，十字军惨败于奥马尔二世之手，此后长枪落入正义兄弟会指挥官艾林·德·古布莱尔手中。十字军自圣地返回时，古布莱尔将这件珍贵圣物带回，此后一直留在王国。

changes.source: Glaives have been an integral part of warfare since 999, when the Erstwick Landsknechts under the command of King Luther drove off the Empire’s Crusaders with little more than their newly-adopted pikes. Similarly to Dies Irae, the relic of Commander Koliash of Monthart, which popularized the use of the halberd, Blood Bane was the relic that made glaives known throughout the faithful world.\\n\\nBlood Bane belonged to Philip of Kunttenburg, an infamous brigand and feared cutthroat descended from a noble Lochland family. Rumor has it that he partook in the Crusade against Erstwick in 999 to make amends for his sinful life—and almost found himself impaled on the end of a pike in a brutal counterattack that left many of his fellows dead. After the brush with death, Phillip decided to modernize arsenal and ordered a powerful glaive be made. After its completion, he had it enchanted by a monk named Gaspar, who was later accused of summoning of devils by the Papal Inquisition.\\n\\n Unaware of the dark enchantments tainting his weapon, Phillip found glory not on the battlefield, but along the royal roads, haunting villages and small towns with a roving army of brigans. His miserable life was ended in the Second Crusade against Erstwick, where once again, to atone for his sins, he was allowed to ride alongside the Crusaders. He was impaled by several pikes in a fruitless charge, and bled to death within minutes, or so the legend goes. After his death, Blood Bane was seized by the Ultherstian Crusaders who returned the fabled relic to the Realm. There, it has changed hands many times, eventually finding its way into the possession of one or more local noble families over the years.
changes.before:
长柄刀自999年起便是战争中不可或缺的一部分，当时厄斯特威克佣兵在路德王麾下，仅凭新采用的长矛便击退了帝国的十字军。与蒙塔尔特的科利亚什指挥官那柄使戟得以普及的圣物"末日审判"类似，"血之祸"是让长柄刀闻名于信仰世界的圣物。

血之祸曾属于孔滕堡的菲利普——一个臭名昭著的强盗、令人闻风丧胆的杀手，出身于洛奇兰一个贵族家庭。传言他在999年参加征讨厄斯特威克的十字军东征，是为了赎清自己罪恶的一生——却在一场惨烈的反击中险些被长矛刺穿，那场反击令他众多同伴丧命。死里逃生后，菲利普决定更新武库，命人打造了一柄强大的长柄刀。完工之后，他请一位名叫加斯帕尔的修士为其附魔，而此人后来被教廷宗教裁判所指控召唤恶魔。

 菲利普浑然不知自己的武器已被黑暗魔力玷污，他所获得的荣耀不在战场，而在王家大道之上——他率领一帮流窜的强盗，袭扰村庄与小镇。他悲惨的一生终结于征讨厄斯特威克的第二次十字军东征，为赎清罪孽，他再度获准与十字军并肩驰骋。他在一次徒劳的冲锋中被数根长矛刺穿，数分钟内便流血而亡——传说如此。他死后，血之祸被乌尔瑟斯特的十字军夺走，他们将这件传奇圣物归还王国。此后它在王国中数易其手，多年辗转之后，最终落入某个或某些地方贵族家族手中。

changes.source: Destroyer was the mighty axe of Vandor the Cruel, chieftain of the barbarian raiders who assaulted the Erebonian Empire in 395 of the Old Era. According to barbarian myths, the axe was forged by the semi-divine smiths Ethor and Unmair in the fabled city of Vallhard. There, barbarian gods and warrior kings waged war eternal between bouts of orgiastic feasting.\\n\\n Regardless of the veracity of ancient myths, the truth is wherever Vandor and Destroyer went, armies and cities fell. Even Bonorium, the Erebornian capital, eventually fell to the barbarian’s might. Vandor would later rename the empire Destroyer carved for him “Gubrinium.”\\n\\nAfter Vandor’s death, his two-bladed axe fell into the possession of Cleonus Flavius, a wandering merchant who brought it to his native city of Galibornium in the Filkland Peninsula. Destroyer remained in the Flavius family until the death of its last member, Honoricus Flavius, and was buried alongside him in the Flavius family tomb.
changes.before:
毁灭者是残暴的凡多尔的战斧，他是旧纪元395年袭击埃雷博恩帝国的蛮族劫掠者首领。据蛮族传说，这把战斧由半神铁匠埃索尔和翁迈尔在传奇之城瓦尔哈德锻造。在那里，蛮族神祇与武士之王在纵宴狂欢之间永无止息地征战厮杀。

 无论古老传说是否属实，事实是凡多尔与毁灭者所到之处，军队与城邦无不沦陷。甚至埃雷博恩人的首都博诺里姆也最终屈服于蛮族的威势。凡多尔后来将毁灭者为他征服的帝国重新命名为"古布里尼姆"。

凡多尔死后，他的双刃战斧落入了游商克莱奥努斯·弗拉维乌斯手中，他将其带回了故乡——菲尔克兰半岛的加利博尼姆。毁灭者在弗拉维乌斯家族中传承，直到末代成员霍诺里库斯·弗拉维乌斯去世，与他一同葬入了弗拉维乌斯家族墓穴。

changes.source: Superstitious commoners have long scared their children with rumors of a “Girdle of Death” which was supposedly crafted in Kluthmorr, the most powerful stronghold of Dark Prophets in the whole of the Empire. Though Kluthmorr lies in ruins today, in the Old Era, it was a city of fantastic wealth and power where cultists the world over would congregate to worship the Cursed Flame and the Lord of Chaos. Given its dark past, Kluthmorr eventually became the Dark Prophet’s stronghold during the Hundred Years War. Cloaked in demon-skin robes, they dwelled in the dungeons below the ruins of Kluthmorr, from whence they hoped to spread their corruption to ever corner of the world. The last inhabitant of the dungeon was Lucius, a self-proclaimed Dark Prophet who was also proven to be the leader of the Children of the New Order.\\n\\n The Cult was discovered in 1019, and many of its supporters were arrested and executed soon after. Lucius himself was taken into custody only after Kluthmorr, then marked for destruction, fell to the Imperial army. The “Girdle of Death,” the symbol of Lucius’ unholy might, was not found on his person. Rumor has it that he secreted the belt away to prevent the church from taking possession of it. Its powers, to this day, remain a mystery...

changes.source: Orc’s Bane was the fabled axe of King Harlior, ruler of the sub-human Thron Empire, deep below the Moonshine Mountain range. Harlior fought the Orcs, who sought to steal his kingdom, tooth and nail. He finally fell in a duel with Khan Rashgar, Lord of the Orcs, who slew the great king with a blow from his mighty hammer. After his death, neither the king’s body nor his magnificent axe were ever found, leading many to believe he would rise from the Netherworld to reclaim his kingdom one day.\\n\\n Orc’s Bane is made of the finest steel, the crafting of which was lost with the fall of Thron. Legends say King Harlior could severed the heads of several Orcs in a single swing; For the Orc’s sake, let’s pray those legends were true.

changes.source: The art of crafting reflex bows was copied by Erebornian bowyers from the Elenians, a mysterious non-human race. Though Elenian bows remain unsurpassed in their craftsmanship, having been enchanted by now-lost druidic magic, the Erebornian’s modern equivalent is still comparable in terms of strength.\\n\\n Perhaps the best known (and most feared) bow among the Erebornians was the reflex bow of Grand Duke Liun'Dren, an Elenian noble, named String of Death. The Grand Duke used it tirelessly to defend his homeland until the Erebornians conquered the Elenian capitol in 395. The Grand Duke, ushering the rest of his forlorn people to safety, carried the bow with him to the Filkland Peninsula, where it was thought to be lost forever.
changes.before: 反曲弓的制作技艺，是埃雷博恩人的弓匠从一个神秘的非人类种族——艾伦尼亚人那里学来的。尽管艾伦尼亚之弓凭借已失传的德鲁伊魔法，在工艺上至今无出其右，但埃雷博恩人当代的等同之作在力量上仍可与之匹敌。\n\n 在埃雷博恩人中，最为人所知（也最为人所畏惧）的弓，当属艾伦尼亚贵族李恩德伦大公的反曲弓——"死亡之弦"。大公不倦地使用它保卫家园，直到395年埃雷博恩人攻占艾伦尼亚首都。大公引领着残余的孤苦族人前往安全之地，携此弓穿越至菲尔克兰半岛，此后它被认为永远失落了。

changes.source: The crafting of Warhammers, more so than any other weapon in history, was a call of challenge from smiths to their fellows. These broad, crushing hammers were forged to combat the ever-increasing strength of plate mail. Needless to say, a weapon crafted to destroy plate mail could – and will – more than easily crush the thing wearing it.\\n\\nOne could say that a cavalry war hammer is a successor to the so-called Ultharian mace. This was a hammer-like weapon, which enabled Grand Duke Ulfmar and his mean to defeat the armies of King Philip Gaspar I in 1001.\\n\\n A classical war hammer is completely made of steel with roundels protecting and reinforcing the haft. The roundels are small, often decoratively formed, metal rings. The haft is approximately half a meter long.

战锤的锻造，比历史上任何其他武器都更像是铁匠向同行发出的挑战宣言。这些宽厚而具有碾压之力的锤器，正是为了对抗板甲日益增长的力量而锻造的。不用说，一件为摧毁板甲而造的武器，当然——也必然会——轻而易举地碾碎穿戴板甲的人。

可以说，骑兵战锤是所谓乌尔萨利亚狼牙棒的继承者。那是一种锤状武器，正是它助乌尔夫马尔大公及其麾下将士在1001年击败了菲利普·加斯帕一世国王的军队。

 古典战锤通体以钢制成，以圆环护盾保护并加固握柄。圆环是一种小巧的、常带装饰造型的金属环。握柄长约半米。

changes.source: Carrying a great club can potentially signify a great many things about a man.\\n\\n One, that he speaks softly. With a weapon of such incredible girth and power, the need to raise one’s voice becomes nonexistent.\\n\\n Two, that he walks tall. Men with proficiency wielding a great club rarely fear other, lesser warriors.\\n\\n And three, that he knows his business, and business is good. That’s really all there is to it.

changes.source: Baroness Linda van Gallagan confessed that she murdered the merchant Kurth Ollmier to retrieve the "Libre Daemonium," written by the dark prophet Lucius. changes.source: Paolus Ventimus is certain that the method of obtaining St. Orthenius' fabled "Inquisitor" relic is detailed in the saint's own legend. According to Ventimus, the key to locating the device lies within the original text of St. Orthenius' tale, written centuries ago by the historian Killian. After Killian's death, the tale was rewritten several times until the truth of the Inquisitor relic was buried beneath the oft-quoted fairytale of a Protector who would rise to free the poor and the oppressed from their servitude. While certainly not the savior the people are hoping for, the true Protector will be the one they need most. Perhaps one day, they will see that.
changes.before: 保卢斯·文蒂穆斯确信，获得圣奥尔特尼乌斯那件传说中的"审判官"圣物的方法，在这位圣徒自己的传奇中已有详述。据文蒂穆斯所言，找到这件神器的关键，就藏在圣奥尔特尼乌斯故事的原始文本之中——那是数百年前由历史学家基利安写下的。基利安死后，这个故事被数次改写，直到审判官圣物的真相被埋没在那则被反复引用的童话之下：一位保护者将崛起，把穷人与受压迫者从奴役中解救出来。这位真正的保护者固然不是民众所期盼的救世主，却将是他们最需要的人。或许终有一日，他们会看清这一点。

changes.source: According to Scripture, Arthamon, along with the demons Baphomet and Cerdie, are the three fallen angels who were cast down alongside their master, Satan, at the dawning of time. Guilty of crimes against God, their Father, they were banished forever from His side and the glory of Heaven, doomed to dwell in eternal darkness. Ever since, they have been trying to seize our world and make it their own, a bitter testament to their hatred of God. If Arthamon has truly been invoked, we shall all soon feel the keen sting of his fiery temper.
changes.before: 据圣典记载，阿尔萨蒙与恶魔巴弗灭、瑟尔迪乃是三位堕落天使，在创世之初与其主撒旦一同被打落天界。因犯下忤逆其父神的罪孽，他们被永远逐离圣座身旁与天堂的荣光，注定在永恒的黑暗中栖身。自那以后，他们便不断试图夺取我们的世界据为己有，这是他们仇恨上帝的苦涩明证。倘若阿尔萨蒙果真已被召唤，我们所有人很快便会尝到他烈火般怒意的灼痛。

changes.source: This spell causes 5*$$X$$d10 points of Fire Damage.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nIf a body of a heretic is turned to dust he can no longer be a threat to the faith or the Holy Mother Church. That is one of the most important dogmas based on the idea that if something does not exist it cannot do anything. Therefore the Inquisition searched for a formula which could instantly turn a heretic's body to dust, for such a formula would have been a great contribution in the fight for the protection of faith. And success came in 888 when at the execution of the self-appointed dark prophet Lucius of the cult of the Children of the New Order the stake was so wet with rain that it could not be lit up. The Inquisitor General Santini burst out with such an anger that he lit up the stake and a few people around it with a single word.

changes.source: This spell resurrects one dead character from the player's party.\\n\\nThis spell affects only dead characters from the player's party.\\n\\nResurrection is one of the biggest miracles one can encounter both in the Holy Scripture and in the real life. With the help of divine mercy, a dead person can be brought back to life. The process of full revitalization of a human being includes the returning of his soul back to his body which means that it is not just a filthy activation of a dead body using a soul brought from the Afterworld by force. It is an act of truly divine love of human. The Resurrection spell is similar to the miracle and it is able to resurrect a person who is close with the caster using the psychological and spiritual bonds between the two.
changes.before:
此法术复活玩家队伍中的一名死亡角色。

此法术只影响玩家队伍中的死亡角色。

复活是无论在圣典还是在现实中最伟大的奇迹之一。借由神圣慈悲，死者得以复生。一个人类完全复苏的过程包括将其灵魂归还其身躯，这意味着这并非以蛮力从冥界召回灵魂来激活一具肮脏的尸骸。这是真正神圣之爱对人类的彰显。复活法术与此奇迹相似，它借助施法者与目标之间的心理与灵性纽带，能够复活与施法者亲近之人。

changes.source: This spell temporarily decreases Strength, Dexterity and Speed of the target by $$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more the attributes of the target decrease.\\n\\nThe heretical practitioners of the Pagan Magic studied the forbidden scriptures of Opiel Maxim, the mage and the alchemist of the Erebornian emperor, and found a formula able to put one in a state similar to the effects of overdose by narcotics, psychotropic substances and poisons. Opiel derived his abilities from pagan god Héroin whose kiss could bring about an ecstatic state of mind as well as painful death. The same spell nowadays uses the metaphysical imprint of faith in Héroin who survived the downfall of paganism and the rise of the true faith.

changes.source: This spell summons a few lightning balls which randomly move around causing Lightning Damage of 20d6 Hit Points.\\n\\nAny spot in the line of sight of the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nLightning was a frequent manifestation of divine wrath at the time of the Erebornian Empire. Unlike the true faith legends, where lightning as a manifestation of divine wrath appears as well, the pagan lightning was not lightning going from sky to the ground but rather a ball of lightning which would suddenly materialize by the sinner and burn him to ashes. A similar principle is used by this spell that concentrates energy with a quality of a ball of lightning on a single spot and thrusts it then against the opponent. This spell was a powerful weapon frequently used against the enemy even by the faithful armies fighting against Ereborn in 223 and despite church bans it has been preserved until nowadays.

施法者视野内的任何地点都可成为此法术的目标。

在埃雷博恩人帝国的时代，闪电是神圣之怒常见的显现方式。正统信仰的传说中同样出现过作为神圣之怒显现的闪电，但与之不同的是，异教的闪电并非自天而降，而是一颗凭空出现在罪人身边、将其烧成灰烬的闪电球。本法术运用的正是类似的原理：将能量凝聚成闪电球的形态，锁定于一点，再掷向对手。此法术是一件强大的武器，甚至在223年讨伐埃雷博恩的虔信军队中也屡屡用来打击敌人；尽管教会明令禁止，它仍留存至今。

changes.source: This spell inflicts Fire Damage of 10d10+$$X$$ Hit Points per second during the time of its effect.\\n\\nAny being in the area of effect can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe legend of the sinful city of Narmazal which was burned down for turning away from the divine pantheon and felling for the seduction of demons is one of the most terrifying passages in the pagan mythology. The gods cast a rain of fire in this story which burned down the city and its inhabitants. Reportedly, the fire rained down from the sky for three days and three nights before the gods calmed down. The pagan mages were inspired by this manifestation of divine power which they studied and derived a formula from it that summons similar powers, although in smaller range. Since this spell was a powerful weapon, it was frequently being used against the enemy even by the faithful armies fighting against Ereborn in 223 and despite church bans it has been preserved until nowadays.

changes.source: This spell allows the player and his party to walk over dangerous places such as chasms, lava and acid pools etc. Doors can be telekinetically opened by casting this spell on them. It is also possible to use this spell to pick up distant items.\\n\\nOnly the player and his party, a door or an item can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana needed to cast this spell decreases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nThe prophet Matheus, being a follower of the First Prophet, found himself in many dangerous situations in the course of his life and often managed to save his life only thanks to a miracle. At his visit of Kassmus city, the Erebornian soldiers pursued him for a mass he served to a river dock where they surrounded him. Matheus protected by his faith stepped on the water surface and miraculously crossed the river Bonthra on feet. That was the first known case of levitation which was then turned to a formula of the Magic of Miracles.
changes.before:
此法术使玩家及其队伍能够穿越危险地带，如深渊、岩浆和酸液池等。对此法术施加于门上可隔空开启门扉。也可用此法术拾取远处的物品。

玩家及其队伍、一扇门或一件物品都可以成为此法术的目标。

施放此法术所需的法力随施法者的精通等级而减少。

先知马特乌斯作为第一先知的追随者，一生中曾多次身陷险境，往往只凭一次奇迹才得以保全性命。他在到访卡斯穆斯城时，埃雷博恩人的士兵因他主持的一场弥撒而追捕他，一直追到河边码头，在那里将他团团围住。马特乌斯以信仰护身，踏上水面，奇迹般地徒步跨过了邦斯拉河。这是已知最早的悬浮案例，后来被转化为奇迹魔法的公式。

changes.source: Wisdom is the priest's strength. Thanks to their wisdom, the priests are able to absorb a lot of information and use it to increase their knowledge and understanding. This helps them understand and perform spells of all magical books.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana necessary to cast a spell and the Stamina loss when casting it decrease. The probability of successfully casting a spell increases and the time needed to restore energy after casting it decreases.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 10\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 46; lvl 22\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 66; lvl 38
changes.before:
智慧是牧师的力量。凭借智慧，牧师能够吸收大量信息，并以此增进自身的知识与理解。这使他们得以领悟并施展所有魔法典籍中的法术。

施展法术所需的法力与施法时消耗的耐力均会减少。施法成功的概率提高，施法后恢复精力所需的时间缩短。

精通等级：
见习生：技能等级 1；智力 1；等级 1
修习者：技能等级 6；智力 18；等级 10
行家：技能等级 11；智力 46；等级 22
大师：技能等级 16；智力 66；等级 38

changes.source: Divine Strike represents a conjunction of divine wrath and the strength of the paladin's arm, i.e. a conjunction of the spiritual and physical sides of justice. A paladin using the Divine Strike will boost his melee attack tremendously, which will however cost him twice as much Stamina.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the paladin is, the higher his chances are to score a Critical Hit which gives him the ability to stun his opponents.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 10; lvl 10\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 20; lvl 16\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 40; lvl 33

神圣打击是神圣之怒与圣骑士手臂力量的结合，亦即正义在精神与肉体两个层面的交汇。使用神圣打击的圣骑士将大幅强化近战攻击，但代价是耐力消耗翻倍。

圣骑士的精通等级越高，打出暴击的几率就越高，暴击使他能够击晕对手。

精通等级：
见习生：技能等级 1；敏捷 1；等级 1
修习者：技能等级 6；敏捷 10；等级 10
行家：技能等级 11；敏捷 20；等级 16
大师：技能等级 16；敏捷 40；等级 33
